m300481.私は主君に恵まれましたし……？: I have been blessed with a good master...?
m300481.私は好きで仕えていますから、\n苦労だとは思ってませんよ。:
I serve them because I enjoy it,
so I wouldn't call it a hardship.
m300481.私は振り回されてる感じです……。: I feel more like I'm being dragged along for the ride...
m300481.私も協力しますわ！\nなんでも任せてくださいませ！:
I'll help as well!
Please leave everything to me!
m300481.穏やかな正月を過ごすつもりが、\n何やらおかしなことに巻き込まれたようだ。:
I was planning to spend a peaceful New Year,
but it seems I've been dragged into some strange situation.
m300481.突然カニが欲しいと言い出した時は驚いたが、\nまぁ、今回はタイミングが良かったな:
I was surprised when he suddenly asked for crab,
but well, the timing works out this time.
m300481.老君、これもまた大きな流れの一つだよ。: Laojun, this is simply part of the greater flow of things.
m300481.老君も、相手を怒らせるようなことは言うべきじゃない。\n常に誠意を大切にね。悪意: Always cherish sincerity. Malice only begets malice.
m300481.聞くまでもねェさ！\n雪合戦の第二回戦をはじめようぜ！:
Don't even have to ask!
Let's start the second round of the snowball fight!
m300481.胃薬なら私が持っていますわよ？: I have some stomach medicine if you need it?
m300481.訓練というのは嘘じゃないが、\n名目上の話だからね。:
It's not a lie that it's training,
but that's just the official reason.
m300481.訓練というのは嘘じゃないさ。\nほら、現在北方で「黒い光冠」だのと、\n色々騒ぎ:
It's not a lie that it's training.
Look, there's a lot of commotion in the North about the "Black Light Crown," right?
m300481.訓練と聞いていたのだが……。\nこれはいったいどういうことだ？:
I was told this was training...
What is going on here?
m300481.誅子も。正月だからとはめを外しすぎですよ。\nほら、お水を飲んでください。:
Zhuzi, too. It's New Year's, but you've really let your hair down.
Here, have some water.
m300481.説明されても分かんねぇのは俺だけか？: You're telling me that, and I'm still the only one who doesn't get it?
m300481.誰かー！ この二人の喧嘩止められる人ー！？: Anyone there! Can somebody stop these two from fighting!?
m300481.迷い家様はこう仰っている、\n『間違った認識だけど楽しそうだから訂正はしない』と:
My Master says,
"It's a misconception, but it looks like fun, so I won't correct them."
I'm sure you can handle them, even if the yōkai start playing around.
m300481.迷い家様も褒めていらっしゃる。\n『頑張った皆におとし玉をあげる』と。:
The Lost House itself is pleased.
It says, "I shall give the otoshidama to everyone who worked hard."
m300481.関係ありません。最悪、力ずくでも引きずっていきます。: There are many lands, such as the domains of nomadic horse clans, that lie beyond the reach of the Flower King's authority.
m300481.頭の悪い仙人に大切な家を荒らされたくはないからね。: The problem is whether Daode Tianzun will agree to help…
m300481.飽き飽きだね、どうせ百年も経てばまた戦国時代さ。: I'm so tired of this. In a hundred years, it'll just be another age of warring states.
m300481.駄目です。酔っていたせいで、\n二人とも気持ちよく寝てしまっています。:
It's no use. They were so drunk
that they've both fallen into a deep sleep.
m300481.魔物の復活以降、中止していた北洋のカニ漁を、\nそろそろ復活させたいと\n漁師た:
Since the revival of the monsters, the Northern Sea crab fishing had been suspended,
but the fishermen had just been urging us
to resume it soon.
m300481.魔物の復活前には、一攫千金を夢みて\n漁師たちが集っていた海域ですからね。: It was a sea area where fishermen once gathered, dreaming of striking it rich, before the monsters' revival.
m300481.黒い光冠の魔物についての調査という話なら、\n私は喜んで協力させてもらおうと思っ:
If it's about investigating the monsters with the black light crowns,
I'd be more than happy to lend a hand.
m300481.（ああ、これが夢なら覚めないでくれ──）: (Oh, if this is a dream, please don't let me wake up...)
m300481.（あのお方が太上道君……またの名を霊宝天尊。\n万物の根源を体現するという三大仙: The last of the Three Great Immortals, said to embody the source of all things.)
m300481.（おいしい食べ物がこんなにたくさん、\nしかもいくら食べても太らないなんて……）:
(So much delicious food,
and I can eat as much as I want without gaining weight...)
m300481.（もしかして元始天尊様と太上老君様って、\nものすごーく仲が悪かったりするんじゃ: It's unlikely. She hasn't left her home in a hundred years.
m300481.（幸せだ……こんな幸せなことがあるだろうか……）: (This is happiness... could there be anything happier...?)
m300481.（歴史、これ歴史だ……絶対に遺さないと！）: (History. This is history... I absolutely must record this!)

m400125.ここは地形を熟知している田園で敵を迎え討つ他に\n手立てはありません。: The only option is to meet them head-on here, where we know the terrain best.
m400125.すでに敵は田園を襲撃するための布陣を整えています。\n敵陣に攻め込むのは危険です: They're already setting up their formation to raid the fields. Attacking their camp would be too risky.
m400125.それと、敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません: Also, defeating enemies won't grant any EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400125.まず大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: First, the sole objective is to eliminate the enemy. Nothing else matters.
m400125.ライフが０になってもクリアとなり\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ\n戦果: Even if your life gauge hits zero, the mission counts as cleared, and the number of enemies you've defeated will be recorded as your achievement.
m400125.今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』となります。: This battle will be a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” focused solely on defeating the enemy.
m400125.今回は敵が奇襲してきます。\n敵の動きが通常よりも速いのでお気を付けください。: The enemy will launch a surprise attack this time, moving faster than usual, so stay alert.
m400125.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—focus on slaying as many monsters as possible.
m400125.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありますので\nご注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please take note.
m400125.敵の大部隊が田園近くに展開しているとの報告が\n入りました。: We've received reports that a large enemy force is deploying near the fields.
m400125.王子、田園を守るため『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Prince, issue the Grand Annihilation Mission to protect the fields!
m400125.自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: Rather than protecting our own forces, the priority is how many foes we can take down.
m400125.被害を最小限にするため、すでに放棄された居住区に\nわが軍の陣地を用意しました。: To minimize casualties, we've prepared our own positions in the abandoned residential area.

m400330.――それから王子よ、どうにもきな臭い噂を耳にした。\nこの件で亜神ディアスが動い:
—And, Prince, I've caught wind of some pretty nasty rumors.
The demigod Dias may be getting involved in this!
Never let your guard down against unknown threats!!
m400330.――ほう、魔王城へ向かうのか。\nかつての戦場に再び立つ戦士、心が踊るなッ！！: ――Ho, heading to the Demon King's Castle, are you? A warrior standing again on the old battlefield—my heart leaps!!
m400330.……これは、激戦になりそうですねぇ。: …Looks like this will turn into a fierce battle.
m400330.……ところで、魔王城の財宝は、\nこっそり大胆に盗んじゃってもいいのか？: …By the way, can we just sneakily and boldly steal the castle's treasure?
m400330.「ライフが０になってもクリア」となりますから、\n敵の討伐を優先し、\n魔王城内: Since “clearing even with zero life” is allowed, prioritize enemy kills and cut down the castle's forces as much as you can.
m400330.「援軍要請」のスキルを持つ兵や、\nワルキューレのような兵科を\n出撃メンバーに: I recommend adding troops with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or units like Valkyries to your deployment roster.
m400330.えぇ、今回は敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を得ることはできないでし: Yeah, this time we probably won't get any EXP, gold, or drops even if we defeat enemies…
m400330.それも抜かりなく♪\nデモシェフ商会の方々が先遣隊として、\n魔界の様子を調査し: We've got it covered♪ The Demochef Trading Company sent a vanguard to scout the demon realm!
m400330.ただ城内には、ガリウスを信奉する、\n多数のデーモンが彷徨っているとのことで……: But inside the castle, many demons who worship Garius are said to be wandering...
m400330.つまりこの戦いは、神の楔捜索隊のため、\n出来るだけ多くの『敵を倒すこと』を\n: In other words, this fight is a mission for the Divine Wedge search team—to slay as many enemies as possible!
m400330.ふむ……それで、\n魔王城の現在地は分かっているのか？\n闇雲に魔界に突入するわ: Hmm… so, do we know its current location? We can't just charge blindly into the demon realm!
m400330.まぁ、知っていたとしても、\n決戦後に回収できたとは思えないが。: Well, even if we knew, I doubt we could retrieve it after the final battle.
m400330.また、今回は特殊な作戦ですから、\n時間経過で出撃コストが回復しません。: Also, this is a special operation, so deployment costs won't recover over time.
m400330.むっ……それはすまんなッ！\nしかしまさか、魔王城に神の楔があるとは……！: Hmm… sorry about that! But to think the Demon King's Castle holds the Divine Wedge…!
m400330.ガオレオンさま、声が大きいですよぉっ！\n執務室が壊れちゃいますぅぅ！: Lord Gaoleon, your voice is so loud! It'll break the office!
m400330.同時に、魔王城の調査も兼ねていますから、\n討伐数もすべて記録されていきます。: At the same time, we're also investigating the castle, so every kill will be recorded.
m400330.敵が数で押してくるなら、\n全部倒せば良いって話だろ？\n今までやってきた事じゃ: If the enemy swarms us, we just have to wipe them all out, right? That's what we've always done.
m400330.決戦後まもなくして、\n魔王城は魔界へ沈んでいってしまいましたからね。: Shortly after the final battle, the Demon King's Castle sank into the demon realm.
m400330.自軍の被害を怖れるなってことね。\nふふっ、私たちらしくて良いんじゃない？: Don't fear casualties on our side. Heh, that's just like us, right?
m400330.連中によれば、魔王城には未だ、\nガリウスを討った時の、三女神の力が残っているら: According to them, the castle still retains the power of the three goddesses from when we defeated Garius. Thanks to that, it's not corrupted by the realm's miasma.
m400330.魔王城は魔王ガリウスが作り出した要塞だからな……。\n財宝なんてどこにもないと思: The castle is a fortress created by Demon King Garius… I don't think there's any treasure anywhere.

m400457.――おぉ～、これが王国、\nそして王国軍と帝国軍の皆さん、と。: —Whoa, this is the kingdom, and the kingdom's army and the empire's troops, huh.
m400457.――ふぁ……あふ……。\n海辺の朝というのも良いものだな。: —Ah… sigh… A seaside morning really is something.
m400457.……やれやれ。\nさて王子、私たちもバカンスに向かおうか。: …Good grief. So, Prince, shall we head off on vacation as well?
m400457.……無断の召喚実験は禁止ですよ？\nちゃんと申請はしてくださいね。: …Unauthorized summoning experiments are prohibited, you know? Please submit a proper request.
m400457.……熱くなりすぎて、\n倒れないように注意するですよ？: …Don't get so heated that you collapse, okay?
m400457.あっ……また後方彼女面してるぅ……。: Ah… she's acting all mysterious behind me again…
m400457.えええええっ！？\nあの子ってセレンさんのお子さんだったんですかぁ！？: Wha—!? That kid is Selen's child!?
m400457.おぉ、あのヴァイスさんが\n熱くなってるの、珍しいですねぇ……。: Oh, Weiss getting all fired up—how rare!
m400457.かき氷……ひやひや、冷たい……。\nわーい……あっまーい！: Shaved ice… so cold, so refreshing… Yay… sooo sweet!
m400457.この合同演習も終わりが近い。\nアナトリア、お前とはそろそろ決着をつけたいものだ: This joint exercise is drawing to a close. Anatolia, it's about time we finally settle things between us.
m400457.それから、喚ばれる相手の都合も考えるんだぞ？\nもし取り込み中だったら大変だろう: And you should think about the person you're calling, alright? It'd be a mess if they're in the middle of something.
m400457.それでは、そろそろ演習の準備を始めましょうか。\n王子、皆さん、よろしくお願いし: Well then, shall we begin the preparations? Prince, everyone, thank you in advance!
m400457.はっ……たしかに……。\nじゃあちょっとだけ考慮しますねー。: Yeah… true enough… I'll consider it, just a little.
m400457.ふふ、よかったら一緒に飛んでみますか？\nスズさんの飛び方、ぜひ見てみたいです！: Hehe, would you like to try flying together? I'd love to see how you fly, Suzu!
m400457.やーだー、申請めんどうですー。: Aw man, paperwork is such a hassle—
m400457.わぁっ、おっきいグリフィン！\n翼もおっきいなぁ……。: Wow, a huge griffin! Its wings are massive too…
m400457.わー！ しますしま～す♪\n――って、んきゃぁぁぁ！？ 何ですかその豪速球！？: Yay! Let's do it♪ —Whoa, what the—!? What's with that blazing fastball!?
m400457.ん、なんだご主人のことを聞きたいのか？\n何を隠そう、ご主人は私が育てたんだ。: Hmm, you want to know about the Master? Let me tell you, I raised him.
m400457.んっ、リンと言ったか？\nどうだ、特製かき氷はいらないか。: Hmm, did you say Rin? How about a special shaved ice—do you want some?
m400457.クロミ！ せっかく海に来たんだ、\n一緒にビーチバレーに励まないか？: Kuromi! Since we've come to the beach, why don't we play some beach volleyball together?
m400457.フッ……絆の深さじゃ親子すら超えるかもしれないな……。\n何しろご主人のことで、: Heh… our bond might even surpass parent-child ties… When it comes to the Master, there's nothing I don't know—
m400457.フフ、ここまでは互いに\nなかなか剣を交えることができなかったからねぇ。: Heh, we've hardly had a chance to clash swords until now, have we?
m400457.熱い日差し、涼やかな海風、\nまるでビーチが\n今日の合同演習を祝福してくれてい: The scorching sun, the cool sea breeze—it's as if the beach itself is cheering on today's joint exercise.
m400457.熱き友との戦いと、灼熱の日差し、\n夏は戦士をアツくする季節なんだよ！: A battle with a hot friend, blazing sun—summer really gets warriors fired up!
m400457.皆さんやる気が漲っているようで何よりです。\n特に今日は、特別ゲストもご招待して: Everyone's enthusiasm is wonderful. Especially today, we have a special guest invited.
m400457.（ふっふー、召喚大成功です。\nこれで今後は、自由に召喚実験も認められ――）: (Heh, the summoning was a total success. From now on I can freely conduct summoning experiments—)

m400546.『大討伐ミッション』は、\n一体でも多くの敵を倒す事が目的です。: The goal of a Great Annihilation Mission is to take down as many foes as possible.
m400546.いやー、大変な事になりましたねぇ。\nもうドレスお披露目会の本番直前だっていうの: Wow, this has really turned into a mess. The dress showcase is supposed to be right before the main event.
m400546.さっき見てきましたけど、お父さん、\n物凄い剣幕でしたよ。娘たちは絶対に渡さん！: I just saw him—he was furious. He swore he'd never hand his daughters over! And if the Prince steps out, he'll make him his sworn enemy.
m400546.しかし、誤解を解き事態を収拾するためには、\n王子本人による説明が必要不可欠です: Still, the only way to clear up the misunderstanding is for the Prince himself to explain. I suspect it could easily turn into a battle…
m400546.では王子、『大討伐ミッション』の発令を！: Then, Prince, commence the Great Annihilation Mission!
m400546.なにぶん、お披露目会を見に来ている観客たちも多く、\n普段のような部隊展開を行う: There are a lot of spectators here to watch the showcase, so we can't deploy our troops the way we normally would.
m400546.はい……。まさか、\n金糸雀姉妹のお父様がジューンブライドの祝祭を\n本物の結婚: Yes… Who would have thought the Goldfinch sisters' father would mistake the June Bride festival for an actual wedding and barge in?
m400546.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールドを\n入手出来ない点にも気を付けて下さい。: Also, keep in mind that defeating enemies won't grant any EXP or gold.
m400546.レナータさんからの報告によると、金糸雀姉妹や\n父親に加え、多数の妖怪たちが集ま: According to Renata's report, the Goldfinch sisters, their father, and a host of youkai have gathered. We'll need to be fully prepared.
m400546.一触即発な親子喧嘩って雰囲気でしたからねぇ。\nなんか、妖怪たちも集まり始めてて: It feels like a powder-keg family feud. Plus, all those youkai are gathering, so talking it out probably won't work.
m400546.出撃コストが時間経過では回復しないため、\nスキル『援軍要請』を持つメンバーや、: Since deployment costs don't recover over time, I recommend bringing members with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or adding a Valkyrie to your squad.
m400546.出撃前の留意事項ですが、今回のミッションは\n敵の討伐を目指す『大討伐ミッション: A quick note before we deploy: this mission is a “Great Annihilation Mission,” aiming to defeat the enemies.
m400546.情報ありがとうございます。\nでは、戦いはあると考えて、\n騒動の現場である式場: Thanks for the intel. Then, assuming a fight is inevitable, let's head to the ceremony hall.
m400546.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、: Even if our base's life hits zero, the number of enemies you've defeated will still be recorded, so don't fear falling—keep pressing the attack.
m400546.王子とランウェイを歩き、\nライスシャワーを受ける目玉イベントを、\n婚姻の儀式: He might be misinterpreting the highlight event—walking the runway with the Prince and getting showered with rice—as a marriage ceremony.

m400571.――た、大変です！\n海の家の前でお客さんたちが暴走しています！:
――Oh no!
The customers are causing a ruckus in front of the beach shack!
m400571.――海の家のお手伝い、ですか？: ――Helping out at the beach shack, huh?
m400571.……いや、そう上手くはいかないようじゃ。\nとんちきなのがやって来たぞ。:
...No, it does not appear to be that simple.
A certain troublesome presence has arrived.
m400571.……うるさい仙人たちよりも、\n昔馴染みのほうが厄介かもしれんのう。: ……Old friends might be even more of a pain than the noisy immortals.
m400571.……こういったときは予測できないことが起こるものです。\nどのような事態にも対応:
……In situations like this, the unexpected can happen.
I recommend preparing thoroughly so you can handle any situation that arises.
m400571.……各国の超有名人たちが手伝う海の家がある。\nそんな噂を聞きつけた人々が殺到し:
……Apparently, word got out that a beach shack staffed by superstars from all over the world was opening.
People have been flooding in ever since.
m400571.……王子殿下も乗り気のようですね。: ……It seems His Highness is up for it.
m400571.あぁ……そういえばスイカの魔物も、\n魔神ビフロンスを信仰してたわね……。: Ah... I suppose the Watermelon Monsters did worship the Demon God Bifrons...
m400571.あとまぁ、普通に店の迷惑になるからのう。: Besides, we're just causing a nuisance to the shop.
m400571.あ～有名人に接客されてぇなぁ～。\nそのことをいずれ生まれてくる子どもや孫に、\:
Ah~ I wish I could be served by a celebrity~.
I'll brag about it to my children and grandchildren
for the rest of my life~.
m400571.いやはや、揉めまくっておるな。\nなにやら変な客も混ざっているようじゃが……。:
My, my, what a commotion.
It seems some rather peculiar guests have mixed in with the crowd...
m400571.いやまぁ、海の家に来るんだから、\n手持ちがないこともないんだろうけどさ。\n君:
I mean, since they came to the beach shack,
they probably have something on them, but…
You're not planning to rob ordinary citizens, are you?
m400571.うるさい仙人たちからは逃げられても、\n昔馴染みからは逃げられんかったのう……。:
I could escape the noisy immortals,
but I couldn't shake off my old friends……
m400571.お前それ王国の王子の前でも言えんの？\nオタクは真夏の砂浜みてぇな過酷な環境に来:
You say that in front of the Kingdom's Prince?
Otaku, don't come to harsh environments like a midsummer beach!
Go read your history books in the shade!!
m400571.お客さんたちの勢いが弱まってきたわね。: The customers' energy seems to be dying down.
m400571.ぐぬぬ……どうやらサボれないようじゃのう。: Hmph... It seems I cannot afford to slack off after all.
m400571.こうして多くの人に慕われるのは嬉しいことですが、\nさすがにこれは看過できません:
While it is heartening to be looked up to by so many,
this has gone far beyond what we can simply overlook.
m400571.この魔物に襲われたせいで、\n海の家は営業できなくなったのですね。: So that is why the beach shack was forced to close its doors.
m400571.これからまた働かねばならんのか……。\n儂はもう愛想よく接客する体力とかないぞ？:
I have to work again...
I have no energy left for pleasant customer service.
m400571.さて、これで作戦は終了か。\nなんだかどっと疲れた気がするよ。:
Well, that wraps up the operation.
I feel completely drained.
m400571.さて、開店じゃ。: Now then. We are open for business.
m400571.す、スイカの魔物！？ どうしてここに……！？: A, a Watermelon Monster?! Why is it here...?
m400571.ずっと正気ではない者もいるようです。: It seems some of them are not entirely in their right minds.
m400571.せっかくですから、王子たちも遊びに来ませんか？\n私たちが店員として接客してあげ:
Since we're here, why don't you join us, Prince and all?
We'll be happy to serve you as your staff♪
m400571.そう、スイカを販売していた海の家の人間たちのように！\nみんなの両手首を捻り上げ:
Just like the humans who ran the beach shack and sold watermelons, Sui!
We will twist both of your wrists
so you can never cut a watermelon again, Sui!
m400571.そうだスイ！ スイカたちは人間を許さないスイ！\nだからこの場の人間たちを倒して:
That's right, Sui! The watermelons will not forgive the humans, Sui!
So we will defeat everyone in this place, Sui!
m400571.そう簡単にはいかないスイ！\nスイカの底力を見せてやるスイ――！！:
It won't be that easy, Sui!
We will show you the true strength of a watermelon, Sui――!!
m400571.そのせいで営業できない状態になっていてね。\n紆余曲折あって、私たちが手伝うこと:
They were in no shape to open for business.
After a bit of a roundabout discussion, we ended up agreeing to help out.
m400571.そのとおりだスイ！\nただ、手伝いが入ったのは予想外だったスイ！:
Exactly, Sui!
However, we did not expect reinforcements to show up, Sui!
m400571.そのとき気づいたスイ。\n人間とスイカは相容れないスイ。\nスイカは人間を打倒し:
That is when we realized, Sui.
Humans and watermelons are incompatible, Sui.
Watermelons must defeat humans... Sui!
m400571.その他、風神雷神の娘たちに、号砲の亜神などなど。\n……人々が押し寄せるのも納得:
Not to mention the daughters of the Wind and Thunder Gods, the Demi-god of the Signal Cannon, and so on.
...I suppose it's no wonder the crowds are surging in.
m400571.そもそもこの程度で疲れるほど、\n君はやわじゃないだろう。: You are hardly the type to tire out from something like that.

Also, defeating enemies won't yield any EXP or Gold.
It's not a situation where we can expect spoils of war,
and we'll be fighting ordinary customers, after all.
m400571.それともなんでスイ？\nビフロンス様が消滅してしまったせいで、\nもう頑張る理由:
Or is that a question, Sui?
Are you mocking the watermelons who have lost their reason to strive
because Lord Bifrons has been annihilated, Sui?
m400571.だから今度は海の家と王子たちを、\nかち割られたスイカみたいに粉々にして、\n確:
So this time, we will smash the beach shack and the Prince and his friends
to pieces, just like a smashed watermelon,
and put them out of business for good, Sui!
m400571.だとしてもですよ。\n臨時とはいえ店員なんですから、真剣に働かないと。:
Even so.
We are employees, even if only temporarily, so we must work seriously.
m400571.ちょっと営業の手伝いをするはずが、\n大騒動に巻き込まれてしまったみたいじゃな…:
I was only supposed to help out with the sales,
but it seems I've been dragged into a major commotion…
m400571.ついでに儂がその辺でぐーたらしておったのがバレて、\n海の家の手伝いに駆り出され:
And since I was caught lazing about in the area,
I got conscripted into the beach shack crew too.
m400571.でしたら早速、お店にご案内して――: Then, allow me to guide you to the shop right away――
m400571.ですが休むわけにはいきませんよ。: But we cannot afford to rest.
m400571.では改めて、お店を開ける準備をしましょうか。\nほら王子様もお客さんの列に並んで:
Then, let us prepare to open the shop.
Come along, Prince. Please join the line of customers.
m400571.となると、一度騒ぎを鎮める必要がありますね。: In that case, we need to calm the situation down first.
m400571.とはいえ嘆いていても始まらんか。\n皆を落ち着かせる作戦をさっさと考えねばな。:
Still, there's no use in lamenting it.
We need to come up with a plan to calm everyone down, quickly.
m400571.どうやら、スイカの魔物はやる気みたいですね。\nそれに見てください、スイカの甘い:
It seems the Watermelon Monster is quite serious.
And look, the scent of the sweet watermelons has attracted a swarm of insect monsters.
m400571.どけッ、ミーハー共がよ！！\n俺は歴史オタクだぞッ！！\nお前らとは偉人を推して:
Move, you fickle masses!!
I'm a history otaku!!
I've been supporting great figures for far longer than you have!!
m400571.どんどんヒートアップしていっていますね。\nこのままですと暴動に発展する可能性が:
The situation is heating up rapidly.
At this rate, it looks like it could easily escalate into a riot.
m400571.どんな事故を起こしたのかは知らないけど、\n本当にみんな両手首を捻挫していたよ。:
I don't know what kind of accident it was, but
they really did all have sprained wrists.
m400571.なんでもスイカの仕入れの際に事故が起きて、\n店員さん全員が両手首を捻挫すること:
Apparently, an accident happened while they were stocking up on watermelons,
and every single one of them sprained both wrists.
m400571.はぁ……善意で店の手伝いをした結果、\nこんな事態に陥るなんてね。:
Sigh... I can't believe helping out a shop out of the goodness of my heart
would lead to this kind of mess.
m400571.ふふっ、そうだったね。\n私たちは、海の家のお手伝いをするんだもん。:
Fufu, that's right.
We are here to help out at the beach shack.
m400571.ふふっ、なんて言う割には、\n真面目にお手伝いを頑張ってたように見えたけどね？:
Heh, for all that complaining,
you seemed to be working quite hard, though?
m400571.ぼ、暴走っていったいなにがあったのよ！？: A ruckus? What on earth is going on!?
m400571.まぁ、それが一番手っ取り早いだろうね。\n分かっているだろうけど、『大討伐ミッシ:
Well, that is the quickest way to handle it.
As you know, a [Massive Subjugation Mission] aims to deal with
as many opponents as possible at once.
m400571.まぁ、それはさておきじゃ。\nそろそろ海の家の開店時刻が来るわけでな。:
Well, setting that aside.
It's about time for the beach shack to open.
m400571.まさか、従業員たちの両手首捻挫の原因は……！\nスイカの仕入れの際の事故って、そ:
No way... the reason the staff all had sprained wrists was...!
An accident during the watermelon delivery... that's what it was...!
m400571.まだまだ暴れている人たちはいますが、\nこの調子なら問題なく鎮圧できそうです。:
There are still some troublemakers causing a ruckus,
but at this rate, we should be able to quell the situation without issue.
m400571.スイカの生き方とはなにか、生きる意味とはなにか。\n答えのないスイカ哲学を考え続:
What is the way of a watermelon? What is the meaning of existence?
We had been musing on these unanswerable questions of watermelon philosophy,
until one day, we witnessed a watermelon being smashed in a watermelon-cutting game, Sui.
m400571.スイカの魔物の沈黙を確認。\nそれから人々も落ち着きを取り戻したようです。:
The Watermelon Monster has gone silent.
It appears the civilians are regaining their composure as well.
m400571.ビフロンス様がいなくなった今、\n我々は自分のスイカ生を歩くことになったスイ。:
Now that Lord Bifrons is gone,
we have been left to walk the path of our watermelon lives, Sui.
m400571.儂は浜辺で果物でも食べて、寝て、\nちょっと肌でも焼いちゃったりして、\n悠々自:
I was planning to just eat some fruit, take a nap, and
get a little tan while lounging on the beach in peace, but……
m400571.儂らがこんなことをするのは、この夏だけじゃからな。\nしっかり目に焼き付けて、思:
We are only doing this for the duration of this summer.
Take it all in and make a memory of it, Prince♪
m400571.全員変ではあったでしょう。: Well, they were all peculiar to begin with.
m400571.夏といえば海、海といえばスイカ。\nならば浜辺に我々がいることはなにも不思議では:
Summer means the sea, and the sea means watermelon.
So there is nothing strange about us being on the beach, Sui.
m400571.実戦は終わりましたし、次は模擬戦ですか？: The real battle is over, so is this a sparring match next?
m400571.客の数が多いなら、ここは『大討伐ミッション』で、\n一気に鎮圧するべきだろうな。:
If there are so many customers, we should use a [Massive Subjugation Mission]
to quell the disturbance in one go.
m400571.少しでも売り上げに貢献するために、\n吟遊詩人のコネを全力で使って、\n拡散しま:
In our attempt to boost sales, we used our bard connections
to spread the word as widely as possible,
and it seems that backfired.
m400571.新しい模擬戦会場はここですか？: Is this the new simulation arena?
m400571.暴徒たちの勢いを削ることが目的だから、\nライフが０となっても作戦は完遂できる。:
The goal is to break the rioters' momentum,
so even if your Life reaches 0, the mission is considered complete.
The bard over there will handle recording the results.
m400571.模擬戦ひとつもらえますか？: May I have a simulation battle?
m400571.歴史に名を残した偉人や亜神が手伝う海の家。\n貴方としては惹かれるものがあるので:
A beach shack run by historical figures and sub-gods.
Surely that sounds intriguing to you, doesn't it?
m400571.浜辺で遊んでいたらたまたま海の家を見つけたんだけど、\nそこの店員さんたちが困っ:
We were just playing on the beach when we happened to spot it, and
the staff there looked pretty desperate.
m400571.海の家に虫……最悪ですね。: Insects at a beach shack... that is the worst.
m400571.王国文化が生んだ悲しきモンスターね。: A tragic monster born of the kingdom's culture.
m400571.白の帝国の初代皇帝と初代騎士団長。\n華の国の設計者の亜神に、偉大なる仙人。\n:
The First Emperor of the White Empire and the First Grandmaster of the Knights.
The Demi-god who designed the Land of Flowers, and the Great Sage.
And then, the Kingdom's First Vice-Commander...
m400571.私たちは店員として、\nまだまだお客さんたちの相手をしなければいけませんから。:
As employees,
we still have plenty of customers to attend to.
m400571.緊急事態なのもあって、今回は補給は間に合いそうにない。\n部隊を展開するためには:
Given the emergency, it's unlikely we'll be able to resupply in time.
To deploy our forces, we'll need to form a unit with someone who has [Request Reinforcements],
or include the Valkyries.
m400571.自分たちの知名度と人気の高さを、\n低く見積もりすぎておったようじゃな。: It appears we underestimated just how famous and popular we truly are.
m400571.見つかってしまったのが運の尽きじゃ。\n仕方がないから、ほどほど真面目に働くとす:
Well, well. It seems my luck has run out.
Very well then. I shall work with a reasonable degree of seriousness.
m400571.言われてみると確かに、スイカ視点のスイカ割りは、\nとても残酷な遊びに見えそうで: Now that you mention it, a watermelon-cutting game from the watermelons' point of view does sound rather cruel.
m400571.責任を取って……というのも変な話じゃが、\n海の家の臨時手伝いとして、一働きして:
Taking responsibility for this... well, that's a strange way to put it, but
let's pitch in for a bit as temporary help at the seaside house!
m400571.迷惑なスイカと衛生的によくない虫には、\nお引き取り願うとするかのう。: We shall ask these troublesome watermelons and unsanitary insects to kindly leave.
m400571.随分と暇そうにしていたからな。\nありがたく戦力にさせてもらったぞ。:
You looked awfully bored, so
I figured I might as well lend you a hand.
m400571.集まった人たちは興奮状態で話を聞いてくれませんし……。\nこのままだと海の家で暴:
The crowd is too worked up to listen to reason…
If this goes on, we might have a riot on our hands at the beach shack.
m400571.順番が来たら接客してあげるよ。\nそれまでに買いたい物とか決めておいてね。:
We'll serve you when it's your turn.
Try to decide what you want to buy in the meantime, okay?
m400571.食べ物や飲み物を色々と取り揃えていますから。\nたくさん買って売り上げに貢献して:
We have a wide variety of food and drinks available.
Please buy plenty and help boost our sales.

m500360.――ファイブ、お前らしくもないな。\nこんな派手なシノギに手を出すとは。:
――Five, this is uncharacteristic of you.
Taking on such a flashy job.
m500360.――ファイブ様、魔神が目を覚ましたようです。: ――Master Five, it seems the Demon God has awakened.
m500360.――モラクスの鎧が砕けたぞ！\nどれ、噂の宝石の盾を拝んでやろうじゃないか。:
――Morax's armor is shattered!
Well then, let's take a look at that famous Gem Shield.
m500360.――王子、至急お耳に入れたいことが。\n闇の組織の動向に関する情報です。: —Prince, there's something I need to tell you right away. It's information about the Dark Organization's movements.
m500360.――魔神モラクスの魔力反応、急速に低下していきます！\nやった！ ボクらの勝利で:
――Morax's magical energy signature is dropping rapidly!
We did it! This is our victory!!
m500360.……そう簡単に逃がすと思うか？: ……Do you think we'll let you escape that easily?

m500360.……捨て駒とは、殊勝な心がけだな。\nファイブめ、上手く部下を飼いならしたか。:
……Sacrificial pawns, huh. A noble sentiment.
So you've managed to tame your subordinates, Five.
m500360.あぁ……これはゴーレム技師の間では\n結構有名なおとぎ話なんです。: Ah... it's actually quite a well-known story among Golem Engineers.
m500360.あの宝石鉱山周辺で、\nそれほどの強大な存在が\n封印されたという話は聞いたこと: I've never heard of a being that powerful being sealed around the gemstone mine...
m500360.いいえ、むしろ魔術師たちによれば、\nこの反応は何らかの\n「封印」が解除されつ: No, quite the opposite. According to the mages, this reaction is a sign that some kind of "seal" is beginning to break.
m500360.うっ……たまにはいいだろ、姐さん！: Ugh…… let me off the hook this once, sis!
m500360.えっと、早とちりかもしれないので！\nでも、少しでも力になれたなら嬉しいです♪: Umm, I might be jumping to conclusions! But I'm glad I could be of some help♪
m500360.お前ら……ちっ、命までかけようとするんじゃねぇぞ。\n金儲けは死んだらできねぇん:
You guys…… Tch, don't go throwing your lives away.
You can't make money when you're dead.
m500360.かつての人類の味方、魔神モラクス様の置き土産、か。\nあーあ、そんなありがたい宝:
A parting gift from the Demon God Morax, humanity's former ally, is it.
Ah, well. I suppose we can't just pocket such a valuable gemstone.
m500360.これは……アンリさん、お手柄かもしれませんよ。: This is... perhaps a great find, Anri.
m500360.さて、私たちはまだ仕事があるぞ。\n捕虜には聞きたいことが山ほどあるからな。:
Now then, we still have work to do.
We have a mountain of questions for the prisoners.
m500360.そして、その終焉の地のひとつである、\nとされているのが、宝石鉱山の近くなんです: And one of the places believed to be where they met their end is right near the gemstone mine.
m500360.その魔神は鉱石の鎧をまとっていて、\nあらゆる物理的な力を反射する、\nとても強: This demon god wore armor made of ore, which reflected all physical force. They were incredibly strong and a great ally to humanity.
m500360.それで、その魔神の最期は……？: And how did that demon god's story end?
m500360.ちっ……もう少し削れるかと思ったんだが。\nまぁいい、もう随分と稼がせてもらった:
Tch…… I thought I could squeeze out a bit more.
Well, fine. We've already made a pretty good profit.
m500360.ですが、宝石の魔神はある日、\n強敵との戦いにおいて、鉱石の鎧を砕かれてしまった: But one day, in a battle against a formidable enemy, the demon god's ore armor was shattered.
m500360.では我々も、一度拠点に戻りましょうか。\n王子、此度の魔神討伐、お疲れ様でした！:
Then let's head back to base as well.
Prince, well done on defeating the Demon God!
m500360.ところで……どうして\nそんなおとぎ話をご存知だったのですか？: By the way... how did you know about such a fairy tale?
m500360.どこへともなく、姿を消したそうです。\n暴走し続ける己を止められなかったのでしょ: They are said to have vanished into the unknown. They probably couldn't stop themselves from going berserk. Surely, they did it to protect their comrades from harm...
m500360.は、はいっ！\nさすがファイブ様だ……これと、この原石と……。:
Y-yes, sir!
As expected of Master Five…… This one, and this rough, and……
m500360.ふぃー……。\nったく、ファイブめ面倒な魔神を復活させやがって。:
Phew…….
Damn it. Reviving such a troublesome Demon God.
m500360.へぇ、純粋な力比べをご所望か。\n王子、あの魔神にどう応えるかは任せるよ！:
Hm, so you want a pure test of strength.
Prince, it's up to you how you deal with that Demon God!
m500360.ま、待ってください！ 後を追うのは危険です！\nこの轟音、聞こえませんか！？:
W-wait! It's dangerous to pursue them!
Can't you hear that rumbling?!
m500360.まさか眠り続ける魔神が周囲を侵食し、\n宝石だらけの洞窟を作ってくれてるとはなァ:
Who would have thought a sleeping Demon God would erode its surroundings
and create a cave full of gems for us.
m500360.まったくです。\n――ですが、この鉱山は使えますね。:
Truly.
――But, we can make use of this mine.
m500360.もうほとんど結界みたいなものですね……。\nおとぎ話が本当なら、\nあの盾は物理:
It's practically a barrier now……
If the fairy tales are to be believed,
that shield should reflect anything other than physical attacks!
m500360.アイリーン姐さん、今ならまだ追えるけど、どうする？: Sis Irene, we can still catch up now. What do we do?
m500360.ゴーレムの駆動音です！\nそれも一体や二体じゃありません！\nゴーレムの軍団がこ:
It's the sound of Golems powering up!
And not just one or two!
A Golem army is heading this way!
m500360.ゴーレムを従え、千年戦争を戦った宝石の魔神。\nゴーレム技師にとっての、偉大なる: A gemstone demon god who commanded golems and fought in the Millennium War. A great predecessor to us Golem Engineers. Their name was—
m500360.ゴーレムを従え、千年戦争を戦った宝石の魔神でしたか。\nどうやら、ここに眠ってい:
So, the Gem Demon God who commanded the Golems and fought the Millennium War……
It seems the one slumbering here was none other than Morax, the Demon God of the fairy tales.
m500360.ファイブ様、ここは俺たちが引き受けます。\n面倒みてもらった恩義がありますから。:
Master Five, we'll handle this.
We owe you for taking care of us.
m500360.ボ、ボクもついていきます！\nもし本当に魔神モラクスがいるなら、\nゴーレムの専:
W-wait! I'm coming with you!
If Morax is really there, we'll need a Golem expert!

Keep this from the other executives.
I'll let you off the hook, so
stuff as much as you can carry before we retreat.

We need to adjust our troop placement quickly.
Prince, please give your orders swiftly!

Just picking up small change won't make us rich.
Since the Demon God exterminators are here,
I'll be taking my leave.

Our pockets―― no, the Organization's funds,
will be quite substantial with this.
m500360.王子、急ぎ迎撃の準備をお願いします。\n敵はゴーレムと――魔神モラクスです！！:
Prince, please prepare for the counterattack immediately.
The enemy is the Golems…… and the Demon God Morax!!

The shield……?

m920082.おいおい！\n豪風の四天王が逃げていくぞ！\n臆病風に吹かれたって訳か？: Hey, hey! The Four Heavenly Kings are running away! Cowardly, blown by the wind?
m920082.かなり上まで登ってきたというのに、\n天狗の姿は見当たりませんね……。: We've climbed pretty high, yet we still can't spot any tengu…
m920082.くっ……。\n王子、霧が更に濃くなっています。\n遠距離兵はさらに戦い辛くなるの: Damn… Prince, the fog is thickening. Long-range units will have an even harder time fighting, so be careful!
m920082.くっ、多勢に無勢か……。\nぬぅううう……。今、王子と戦えば敗北は必至……。\n: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: Damn, outnumbered… Ugh… If we fight the Prince now, defeat is certain… We have no choice but to retreat!
m920082.くっくっく……天狗山に出向くのも随分と久しいですね。\nさて、今日こそは目障りな: Heh heh heh… It's been ages since we last set foot on Tengu Mountain. Today, we'll finally crush those pesky Tengu.
m920082.こ、これはとんだ失礼を！\n私の国では人間に化ける猫の物の怪がいたゆえ、\nてっ: What a grave insult! In my country there are cat youkai that disguise themselves as humans, so I completely mistook you for a monster…
m920082.こちらこそ宜しくお願いしますね、アオバさん。\nそれでは王子、帰還するとしましょ: The pleasure's mine, Aoba-san. Well then, Prince, let's return!
m920082.この山は天狗の棲む神聖な山ぞ。\n戯れに汚すのであれば、\n其方らを山の肥やしと: This mountain is a sacred realm where Tengu dwell. Should you defile it for sport, making you fertilizer for the mountain would be all too easy.
m920082.この旅の目的はただ一つ……。\nそれは、私の故郷を滅ぼした\n酒呑童子という名の: My only purpose on this journey is one thing... to slay the demon called Shuten-dōji, who destroyed my hometown.
m920082.この程度で音をあげるとはどういうことだ！\n日の出前から始めて、まだ二つしか終わ: How can you give up so easily! We started before sunrise and you've only finished two already? I won't let you rest until it's all done!
m920082.この辺りはもう人が住んでいない廃屋しかないですし、\nまさかゴブリンが現れるとは: There are only abandoned houses around here, no one lives here, so I never expected goblins. You two are impressive!
m920082.これほど不利な状況にあっても、\nカラス天狗やかまいたちらを負かすとはな……。: Even in such a dire situation, you managed to defeat the crow Tengu and the kamaitachi….
m920082.これ程までに成長していたとはな。\nよし、いいだろう。此を以て最後の修行とする。: I never expected you to have grown this much. All right, this will be your final trial. Come on, Aoba! Endure my onslaught!
m920082.しかし、やっかいだな。\nまさか、天狗と人間、それもあの王子が手を組むとは。: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: This is troublesome. Who would have thought a tengu and a human, and even that Prince, would join forces?
m920082.しかし、今の私の力では\n強大すぎる酒呑童子に勝つことなどできません。: But with my current strength, I have no chance against the overwhelming Shuten-dōji.
m920082.じ、獣人……！？\nそれは一体どういう事だ……？\n物の怪が化けた姿ではないのか: Beastperson…!? What does that even mean? Isn't she just a monster in disguise!?
m920082.じ、神通力……！？\nそれでは、私たちはこの森から出られないのですか？: Shintō power…!? Does that mean we can't get out of this forest?
m920082.すごい……アオバさんの援護射撃のおかげで、\n難なく魔物を一掃することができまし: Amazing… Thanks to your support fire, Aoba, we cleared the monsters without trouble.
m920082.ぜ、是非ご案内いただきたい！\n勿論、ただでとは言いません。修行を終えた後は、\: I-I'd be honored if you'd guide me! Of course, I won't ask for a free ride. After my training, I promise I'll lend my strength to the Prince and his allies!
m920082.そ、そんな……！\n申し訳ありません、王子。視界が悪くて、\n遠くに矢を射る事が: N-no…! I'm sorry, Prince. The visibility's terrible, I don't think I can shoot arrows that far…
m920082.そ、そんなぁ……。\nまだ掃除は続けるのですね……ハァ。: Wh-what… So the cleaning's still going on… *sigh*.
m920082.そうだ、それで良い。\nぬらす、ふきとる、ぬらす、ふきとる。\nこの動きを忘れる: That's it, just like that. Wet it, wipe it, wet it, wipe it. Don't ever forget this motion.
m920082.そうだね……。\n今は生きていると分かっただけで良いよ……。: Right… Just knowing they're alive is enough for now…
m920082.そうですね。\n一度、私達の仲間のいる所に行ってみましょう。: That's right. Let's head to where our companions are first.
m920082.そうですね。\n王子、では私達も山へ登りましょう！: That's right. Prince, then let's climb the mountain too!
m920082.そこで私は、天狗山に住むと言い伝えられる\n高名な天狗の許で修行をすべきと考えた: So I decided I should train under the famed tengu said to live on Tengu Mountain.
m920082.それが本当なら、\n天狗がアオバさんに力を貸してくれる可能性も\nゼロとは言い切: If that's true, we can't say there's zero chance the tengu might lend you power, Aoba.
m920082.それと、王子、我が修験にお付き合い頂き感謝します。\n約束通り今よりアオバは貴方: And Prince, thank you for joining me in my training. As promised, from now on I'll be your strength. I look forward to working together!
m920082.それに、バシラさんは妖怪ではありませんよ。\nれっきとした「獣人」です。: Besides, Bashira isn't a youkai. She's a bona-fide beastperson.
m920082.それに、酒呑童子の血肉を得た……と、言っていました。\n同族となったのであれば、: Besides, you said you'd taken Shuten-dōji's flesh… If you've become one of them, his followers won't kill you so easily.
m920082.それにしても、王子は本当に人間なのですか？\n物の怪をも上回る力をお持ちの様に見: Still, Prince… are you really human? You seem to wield power beyond any youkai… You even communicate with the troops without a word.
m920082.それよりもアオバ殿。本当に天狗に会いに行くのか？\n拙僧ら修験者であっても、\n: More importantly, Aoba, are you truly set on meeting the tengu? Even for us ascetics, the climb up this mountain is treacherously steep.
m920082.そんな……！\n鬼刃衆があてに刃を向けるなんて……！？: No…! The Oni Blade Squad turning their blades on Atei…!?
m920082.だって……みんなが……\n鬼刃衆が生きてたんだ……！: But… everyone… the Oni Blade Squad is alive…!
m920082.ちっ……。\nここで倒すつもりだったが、逃がしちまったか。: Tch… I intended to finish it here, but it's escaped.
m920082.ちょ、ちょっとアオバさん！\n王子は、もちろん人間ですよ！: Hey, hey, Aoba! The Prince is, of course, human!
m920082.ちょ、ちょっと待ってください！\n彼女達は化け猫ではありません！: W-wait a moment! They're not masquerading cats!
m920082.ちょ、調子に乗るでないわ！\nまだ少し早いかも、と前置きしただろうに……！\nま: Hey, don't get cocky! I told you it might be a little early…! Honestly, that's just like you…
m920082.ですが、天狗も鬼と同じように\n悪い妖怪なのではないのでしょうか……？: But… aren't the tengu just as bad as demons?
m920082.というのも、私は天狗山の詳しい場所を\n知らないのです……。: You see, I don't actually know where Tengu Mountain is…
m920082.どうか私めを弟子にして頂きたい！\n鬼に殺された故郷の者たちの仇を討つため、\n: I beg you to take me as your disciple! To avenge my hometown, slaughtered by demons, I wish to master unrivaled strength!
m920082.なぜなら、天狗は妖怪の身でありながら、\nかつて人間に武芸を伝授したという伝説が: Because legend says that, although tengu are youkai, they once taught martial arts to humans—a story that's been passed down in my hometown for ages...
m920082.ぬぅ……。彼奴ら、まだ自我が残っておったか……。\nもう少し時間がかかる様だな。: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: Huh… they still retain some will… It'll take a little more time. There's nothing we can do. I'll leave for today.
m920082.は、はいぃ………………うぅぅ。\nでもコノハ様ぁ……私、もう何時間も拭き続けてい: Y-yes… uuu… But, Lady Konoha… I've been wiping for hours now, and my hands and shoulders just won't stop hurting…
m920082.は、はいっ！\nもっと修行に励みます……！: Y-yes! I'll work harder on my training…!
m920082.はぁ、はぁ……ダメです。\n完全に天狗様を見失ってしまいました。\nもう、完全に: —Pant, pant… It's no use. I've completely lost sight of the Tengu. The darkness has swallowed everything….
m920082.はい、分かりました！\n餓鬼など、今の私の敵ではありません。\nコノハ様が満足す: Yes, understood! Those hungry spirits aren't my opponents right now. I'll give you a battle worthy of your satisfaction!
m920082.はい。私の決意に曇りはありません。\n天狗の教えを受け、天下無双の力を体得せねば: Yes. My resolve is unwavering. I must learn the tengu's teachings and master unrivaled power, or my great ambition will never be fulfilled…
m920082.ふむ、アオバのやつめ、\n四肢の筋力は十分に備わったと見える。\nだが、体力の方: Hmm, Aoba seems to have built up good limb strength. But I wonder about his stamina… Haa—!!
m920082.ふむ、アオバ殿の得物はかなり風変わりな逸品ゆえ、\nそれを使いこなすとはまったく: Hmm, Lady Aoba's weapon is quite an unconventional masterpiece, and to wield it so well—truly humbling.
m920082.ふむ、天狗の気配が消えたか。\n……全く以て不思議な存在だのう天狗とは。: Hm, the tengu's presence has vanished… What a mysterious being, that tengu.
m920082.ふん……調子の良い奴め。\nだがそうした単純さは其方の強みでもあるな。: Hmph… You're getting cocky. Still, that simplicity is also your strength.
m920082.ほ、報告！ 牛頭の魔物が多数出現！\nさらに、どの個体にも攻撃が全く通じない模様: R-report! Numerous Ox-Head Demons have appeared! Moreover, none of our attacks seem to affect them at all…!
m920082.ほう、人間のくせになかなかやりおる。: Hmm, humans sure know how to put on a show.
m920082.ほう、鬼とな？ しかし、其方は人間であろう？\n自らの力を計らぬその無謀な志は、: Ah, you seek to become a demon? Yet you are but human. Such reckless ambition, untested, will only lead to your ruin.
m920082.まずいですね……。\n霧が出ている時は、普段通り遠くの敵に\n攻撃を当てる事は困: This is bad… When the fog's out, hitting distant enemies as we normally do will be difficult.
m920082.まだ少し早いかもしれぬが、\n特別に其方にはコレを渡しておこう。\n有り難く受け: It might still be a bit early, but I'll make an exception and give you this. Accept it gratefully.
m920082.まだ粗削りではあるが、素養はあるとみえる。\n其方、確か名をアオバと言ったな？\: It's still rough around the edges, but you've got the talent. And you said your name was Aoba, right? Fine, I'll train you personally.
m920082.まったくもう！ アオバさんってば何でも疑って……！\n天狗様に、妖怪と人間の区別: Good grief! Aoba-san doubts everything…! Please have the Tengu teach you how to tell youkai from humans in training!
m920082.もちろん天狗も妖怪のひとりですから、\n危険な存在であることには変わりありません: Of course, tengu are also youkai, so they're still dangerous. But now I have no choice but to believe in the tengu legends.
m920082.よく耐え抜いたな、アオバ。\n今日の修行はここまでとしよう。: You held out well, Aoba. That's enough training for today.
m920082.より強くなりたいと望むのならば、\n明朝からは灯篭だけでなく\n寺の壁の掃除もし: If you want to become stronger, starting tomorrow you'll clean not just the lanterns but also the temple walls.
m920082.アオバよ、この窮地を好機へと転じてみせよ！\n今こそ稽古の成果を示す時なり……。: Aoba, turn this dire situation into an opportunity! Now's the time to show the results of your training… Use the techniques you've honed here to drive them back!
m920082.アオバ殿、天狗を追いましょう。\n今ならば、追いつけるかもしれぬ。: Lord Aoba, let us pursue the Tengu. We might still catch up.
m920082.アンナさん、ゴブリン達が現れたのは、ここです！: Anna, the goblins showed up right here!
m920082.カカカッ。\nあの三大妖怪の一柱、\n酒呑童子に本気で挑むつもりでおるのか。: Kaka… Are you really planning to take on one of the three great youkai, Shuten-doji?
m920082.グ、グフッ――！？\nあそこにいるのは人間達……ッ！？\n少数ならいざしらず、人: G—Guff…!? Those over there are humans…!? If it were just a few, maybe, but there are far too many…
m920082.グハハハ！\n生ぬるいと言っておるだろう。水よ。\nこの山ごと、わしの雷の餌食に: Guhahaha! I told you it was too soft, Water. I'll make this whole mountain a feast for my thunder!
m920082.グフフフフ……！\nこの砂漠を越えれば、東の国は目と鼻の先……。: Guffaw…! Once we cross this desert, the eastern lands are just around the corner….
m920082.コノハ様……！ \n本当に、本当に有難うございました……。: Lady Konoha…! Truly, thank you so much…
m920082.シ、酒呑童子様……ノ……血肉ヲ得……\n我ラ……修羅……畜生……ラセツ、ガ道ヲ、: S-Shuten-dōji… we seek your flesh… We, the Shura beasts, will blaze the path… A sudden gust of wind… arrives… and we come.
m920082.バシラさんがそう仰るのも無理はありません。\nですが、酒呑童子率いる鬼の一族と天: It's understandable you'd think that, Bashira. However, the demon clan led by Shuten-doji has long been at odds with the tengu.
m920082.人気のない廃屋に誘い込み\n人間を喰らうつもりだったのだろう！\n化け猫め、私が: You lured us into this deserted house to devour humans, didn't you? Masquerading cat, I'll be the one to bring you down…!
m920082.人間どもめ……覚えていろッ……！\n次こそは必ず強大な力を持つ妖怪とともに、\n: You humans… remember this…! Next time, with a truly powerful youkai, we'll wipe you out…!
m920082.仕方ない。\nそこまで言うのならば稽古をつけてやろう。\n構えろ！ アオバ！: Fine. If that's what you want, I'll give you a lesson. Get ready, Aoba!
m920082.他の妖怪の仲間になろうと考えていたとなると、\n動きが気になるな……。: If it's looking to join other youkai, its movements are worth watching…
m920082.伝承によれば天狗の教えを受けた人間は、\n天下無双の武人に至ったとされており、\: According to the tales, anyone who receives a tengu's teachings becomes a peerless warrior. I'm determined to master that power, no matter what.
m920082.全妖怪の長にならんと企む鬼達は、\n修験によって卓越した力と知識を備える天狗を支: The demons, who plot to become the rulers of all youkai, have repeatedly assaulted Tengu Mountain, trying to seize the tengu's superior strength and knowledge gained through ascetic practice.
m920082.卑劣な……！\n何が何でもここであの化け猫を撃ち倒し、あの方たちを\nお救いしな: Despicable…! I must shoot that masquerading cat down here and save those people… Aoba, onward!
m920082.右手で濡れ拭き。\n左手で乾き拭き。\n分かるか？ アオバよ。: Wipe it with your right hand while it's wet, dry it with your left. Got it, Aoba?
m920082.大方、我が力を欲する邪悪な妖の手先であろう。: They're likely minions of a wicked demon craving my power.
m920082.天狗が人間に肩入れしてるとなれば、\n少々厄介になってきたな。\n酒呑童子様に報: If the Tengu are siding with humans, things just got messy. I'll report back to Shuten-doji.
m920082.天狗の山？\nうーん、あたしは知らないけど、\nもしかしたら仲間の誰か知ってる人: The Tengu Mountain? Hmm, I don't know, but maybe someone among our allies does.
m920082.天狗様！ 私の話を聞いて下さい！\n実は、私は酒呑童子を倒す力を得る為に、\n貴: Tengu! Please hear me! Actually, I've been searching for you to gain the power to defeat the Shuten-dōji.
m920082.実は、詳しい場所が分からず、\n困っていたところでした。: The problem is, I have no idea exactly where that place is, and I was at a loss.
m920082.小賢しい妖術使いって訳か。\n面倒くさいのは嫌いだ。\nつまり、本体を見つけてと: So it's some clever illusionist, huh. I hate dealing with hassles. In other words, just find the real one and take it down, right?
m920082.屈服など生ぬるいぞ。水よ。\nわしなら羽をむしり取り、殺し尽くしてやるわい。: Subduing them? That's too soft. Water, heed my call. I'll tear out their wings and slay them all.
m920082.左様。\nだが、分身といえど本体と同等の力を持っている。\n王子、十分にご注意な: Exactly. But even the duplicates possess strength equal to the original. Prince, please be very careful.
m920082.引き続き、妖怪全体の動きにも注意が必要ですね。\n王子、それでは帰還するとしまし: We still need to keep an eye on the overall youkai activity. Prince, let's head back then.
m920082.待って！ みんな、待ってよ！\nあてを置いていかないで……！: Wait! Everyone, wait! Don't leave Atei behind…!
m920082.復活した大妖怪、酒呑童子の傘下に入り、\n必ずや憎き人間どもを根絶やしにしてやる: Having joined the resurrected great youkai, Shuten-dōji's forces, we will surely eradicate those hateful humans.
m920082.我が団扇が生ぬるい風を操るだけの\nものだと思っておったら大間違いだぞ。\nじわ: You thought my fan only summoned a gentle breeze? Big mistake. Feel this heat wave that saps your stamina bit by bit!
m920082.掃討完了……。\n皆さん、お怪我はありませんか？: The sweep's complete… Is anyone hurt?
m920082.操られているのかもしれませんね……。\n今は、無力化することに専念しましょう。: They might be being controlled… For now, let's focus on neutralizing them.
m920082.攻撃が通じぬとな……？\nむぅ……。異国の妖怪には、不思議な妖術で分身を\n作る: Attacks don't work, you say…? Hmm… I've heard that some foreign youkai can create duplicates with mysterious sorcery…
m920082.来る日も来る日も雑用ばかりで……耐えられません！\nもう……山をおります！: Every day it's just chores… I can't take it! I'm leaving the mountain!
m920082.此処がアオバ殿が探し求めていた天狗山の登口だ。: This is the trailhead of the Tengu Mountain you've been searching for, Aoba.
m920082.無駄とも思えた、あの拭き掃除が、\nこんなにも私を強くしてくれてただなんて……。: That cleaning I thought was useless actually made me this strong… I'm truly impressed by your teachings, Lady Konoha!
m920082.然り。我が名は天狗山の主、コノハ。\nして、何用だ人間よ？: Indeed. I am Konoha, lord of the Tengu Mountain. What brings you, humans, here?
m920082.王子、すぐに戦いの準備をお願い致します！: Prince, please prepare for battle at once!
m920082.王子、駆けつけて来て下さり、ありがとうございます。\n私が牛頭の魔物を目撃したの: Prince, thank you for coming to our aid. I saw the Ox-Head Demon around here.
m920082.王子、鬼刃姫、こっちだ。\n見てくれ。以前、鬼刃衆が捕らえられていた場所を\n未: Prince, Kibahime, over here. Look—the place where the Demon-blade troops were captured is still being watched by the Shuten-doji's minions.
m920082.王子よ、拙僧らも山へ赴かぬか？\n大敵にも臆せず、自ら厳しい修験を積む者を前にし: Prince, shall we also ascend the mountain? Facing someone who fearlessly endures harsh ascetic training against a great enemy, we cannot simply stand idle.
m920082.確かに、酒呑童子とはいずれまた戦う事に\nなるでしょうし、アオバさんの修行を援護: Indeed, we'll eventually have to face Shuten-doji again, and supporting Aoba's training will be beneficial for us as well.
m920082.確かにそうみたいね……。豪風の四天王も\n定期的に出入りしているという事だけど、: It certainly seems that way… The Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale also come and go regularly, so something must still be hidden there…?
m920082.私の名前はアオバ。\n妖怪退治専門の狙撃手として\n各地を旅している者です。: My name is Aoba. I'm a sniper who travels the lands, specializing in exterminating youkai.
m920082.私は、生まれた時からこの姿なんです！: I've looked like this since birth!
m920082.私もそんな気がしていました。\n……まっすぐ走っていたはずなのに、\nそんなこと: I felt the same. We were supposed to be running straight, yet… how could this be?
m920082.精神、武技、そして肉体……全ての理を悟り、\nお前自身が己という器の限界を越える: Mind, technique, and body… grasp all the principles, and by surpassing the limits of your own vessel, you'll finally understand the meaning of that certification.
m920082.見たところ、自らの意思で山に踏み入ったようだな。\n……いいだろう。我ら天狗の山: ???: It looks like they entered the mountain of their own volition. …Very well. Let's test with our divine power whether they're worthy to step onto the tengu's mountain.
m920082.賢明な判断ですね……。\nそれでは人間どもよ。\n次に見える時を楽しみにしてます: Wise decision… So, humans, enjoy the next time we meet… heh heh heh.
m920082.逃がすものか、豪風の四天王――\nって……あ、あれは……！？: We won't let them escape, Four Heavenly Kings—wait… what's that…!?
m920082.過ぎたことですし、気にしないで下さい。\nそれよりも妖怪を退治することに\n並々: That's all in the past, so don't worry about it. More importantly, you seem unusually eager to hunt down youkai, don't you?
m920082.酒呑童子……！？ \n一体何を言っているの……？: Shuten-dōji…!? What on earth are you saying…?
m920082.酒呑童子に早急に合流したいのだが、\n我ながら運が悪すぎる……！ \nこうなれば: I want to rejoin Shuten-dōji quickly, but my luck is terrible…! At this point, I'll counter with my illusionary duplicate technique.
m920082.餓鬼……ッ！？\n一体どうしてヤツらが此処に？: Hungry spirit…!? Why are they here?
m920082.驚いた……まさか立っていられるとは思わなんだ。\n合格だ、アオバ。其方の執念には: I'm impressed… I never thought you'd still be standing. You pass, Aoba. I'm humbled by your determination.
m920082.鬼刃姫、近づくんじゃない！ \n何か様子がおかしい。\n彼らは明らかに敵意を持っ: Kibahime, don't get close! Something's off. They're clearly hostile.
m920082.鬼刃姫さん、冷静になってください！\nあの状態では、今は放っておくしかありません: Kibahime, please calm down! In that state, we have no choice but to leave them be.
m920082.（――おい！ 豪風の四天王が帰っていくぞ……！\nどうする？ とっ捕まえた方が良: (—Hey! The Four Heavenly Kings are leaving… What should we do? Should we try to capture them!?)
m920082.（――！ 皆静かに。\n豪風の四天王が出てきたぞ……）: (—Everyone, stay quiet. The Four Heavenly Kings have appeared…)
m920082.（いざとなれば彼奴らを使う事も考えねばな……。\n酒呑童子様の血肉を与えたとはい: Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: (If it comes to it, we may have to use them… Though we gave them the Shuten-doji's flesh and blood, their bodies haven't fully regenerated yet…)

m920193.――おぉ、久しいな王子よ！\nまだ戴冠しておらぬと聞いたが、随分と立派になった！:
――Ah, it has been a long time, Prince!
I heard you have not yet been crowned, but you have grown quite the man!
m920193.――おっと、話はまた後で、だ。\nこの気配……仙人、いや、邪仙のものだね。\n随:
――Oh, we can continue that later.
That presence…… it belongs to an immortal, or rather, a wicked immortal.
He's quite close…… Prince, he's heading this way!
m920193.――ここは、余の国である。\nまさか余を出し抜き、正門から抜けられると思ったか？:
This is my country.
Did you truly think you could outsmart me
and slip out through the main gate?
m920193.――と、言うとおもって連れてきたんですよ。:
That's exactly what I thought,
so I brought you along.
m920193.――どうせなら、存分に踊り尽くしてやりましょう。\nまずは作戦会議ですね。: ……If we're going to dance, let's do it with all our might. First, a strategy meeting.
m920193.――オリュンポス第二層、崑崙にて、\nあなたたちを待っていますよ。: ……At the Second Layer of Olympus, in Kunlun, I await you.
m920193.――ワシをここまで追い詰めるか。\n名高き華王が武将、武成豪侠と呼ばれる者だ……:
――So you've cornered me, have you?
The famed general of the Flower Kingdom, the one called Takei Goukyou?……
m920193.――十天君の討伐は、我らが悲願。\n金光聖菩よ、その首討たせてもらうぞ！:
Slaying the Ten Heavenly Kings is our greatest wish.
Jinguang Shengpu, I shall take your head!
m920193.――戦況確認。\n敵戦力の空白が認められます。\n端的に言えば、逃げるなら今です:
――Assessing the battlefield.
A gap has opened in the enemy's formation.
To put it bluntly, if you're going to run, now is the time.
m920193.――王国軍本隊と合流させるな！\n仙人があちらについているとはいえ、\nこちらに:
――Do not let them link up with the royal main force!
Even if an immortal is with them,
we have the Voice of Heaven on our side!
m920193.――華の国からの正式な招待とは……。\n確か、彼の国は未だ復興の最中だったのでは:
――A formal invitation from the Flower Kingdom, is it……?
I thought that nation was still in the midst of its reconstruction?
m920193.――覚悟ができているようで何よりだ。\n十天君がひとり、狛天君の首、僕がもらい受:
Takei Goukyou?: ――I'm glad you're prepared.

One of the Ten Heavenly Kings… I'll take Komaten's head for myself!
m920193.――言われずとも、姿くらい見せましょう。\n久しい顔ばかりですね。:
Without being told,
I suppose I should show myself.
It has been a long time.
m920193.――誅子も、随分と背丈が伸びたようだ。: ――You seem to have grown quite a bit taller, Chushi.
m920193.――陛下、王国の者らが到着しました。: ???: ――Your Majesty, the Kingdom's party has arrived.
m920193.…………くっ。\nこれでも届かないというのか！？:
……Grr.
Is this still not enough to reach you?!
m920193.…………ッ！！\n太公望、その減らず口、徹底的に縫い合わせてやろうか！:
……!!
Taigong Wang, shall I stitch that insolent mouth of yours shut?
m920193.…………尋問のつもりかな？\nあいにくと、口の堅さには自信があるんだ。:
…………Are you planning to interrogate me?
I take great pride in my discretion.
m920193.……お互い様ということで。\n――王子殿！ 敵は騎兵を出しています！\n兵の陣形:
……Let's call it even, then.
―Your Highness! The enemy is deploying cavalry!
Be careful with your troops' formation!
m920193.……このままだと、\n狛天君の首は王国に渡ってしまう、か。\nそれはまずいな……:
……At this rate,
Komaten's head will end up in the Kingdom's hands.
That's a problem…… yes, quite a problem.
m920193.……そんな建前は結構。\nあなた程の武将が焦ってトドメを奪いに来たのです。\nお:
……I suppose that's a fair enough pretext.

For a general of your caliber to rush in and deliver the finishing blow…

There must be a reason why you felt you had to.
m920193.……っ！ 後で覚えておけ、妙道！: ……! You'll pay for that later, Miaodao!
m920193.……でも、うん、間違ってないですよね。\nあの人はもう、私たちの仲間ですから。:
……But, yes, we were right, weren't we?
That person is one of us now.
m920193.……と言いたいところなんだけど、\n今回はむしろ、助けを求めるべきかな。:
……That's what I'd like to say, but
in this case, I should probably ask for help.
m920193.……はっ。御意に。\n――それにしても、随分と王らしくなられて。:
……Yes, my lord. As you command.

――And yet, you've truly become quite the king.
m920193.……ん？\n華王……そのチューシ様って人が生きてるなら、\nむしろ復興がさくさく:
……Hm?
If that King Zhu Zi is alive,
shouldn't the reconstruction be going much more smoothly?
m920193.……クッ、ククク。\nヌハハハハハッ！ 何を生ぬるいことをッ！:
……Kuh, kuku.
Nuhahahahaha! What a soft, pitiful lot you are!
m920193.……来た、か。\n聞忠よ、この場は余のみで十分である。\n貴様は他の十天君を追う:
……So they've come.

Wen Zhong, this place is sufficient for me alone.

You go and pursue the other Ten Heavenly Kings.
m920193.……王子が金光聖菩を渡さないと決めたのも、\nまたひとつの過ちですからね。:
……The fact that the Prince decided not to hand over Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu
is also a kind of mistake, wouldn't you say?
m920193.……聞忠、誅子、共に姿を消したようです。\nあれはもはや仙術などではない、\nそ: ……Wen Zhong and Zhuzi have both vanished. That was no longer mere immortal arts… It was the very power of a sub-god…
m920193.……西へ逃げたか。\nそちらの方角には、いま彼らがいるはずだけど――:
……He fled west.
They should be heading in that direction right now, but——
m920193.……邪仙と言えど、まさかその首をはねるとは。\nまったく、君らしくもないやり方だ:
……Even a wicked immortal… I didn't expect you to just behead him like that.

Truly, that's not very like you, is it,
Fei-Long, one of the generals of the Kingdom of Flowers?
m920193.……馬鹿だよね、そんなことしなくてもさ、\n誅子様がいい王様だってことは皆知って:
……That's ridiculous, isn't it? Even without that,
everyone knows Lady Zhuzi is a good ruler.
Time would have resolved any doubts on its own.
m920193.ああ、聞忠がまた誅子様をさらった以上、\n今度こそ、僕は立ち上がらないといけない:
Ah, now that Wenzhong has abducted Lady Zhuzi again,
I really must rise up this time.
m920193.あっち！ あの路地は大丈夫だよ！\n先行したナタク様たちが押さえてくれてる！:
That way! That alley is safe!
Lord Nataku and the others are holding it down!
m920193.あの方のお人好しは誅子様限定で、\n視野が狭くて、めちゃくちゃ過保護で、\nでも:
His naivety is exclusive to Lady Zhuzi,
his perspective is narrow, and he's incredibly overprotective,
but that's what makes him who he is.
m920193.いやいや、最初に手傷を負わせたのは僕ですから。\n狩りの獲物とは、\n先に矢を射:
Oh, but I was the one who wounded him first.

In the hunt, surely the right to the kill belongs to the one who loosed the first arrow?
m920193.うむ、無礼を働いたならば謝ろう。\n此奴は忠義者にすぎるがゆえ、\n少々手段を選:
I see. I will apologize for the rudeness.
He is too loyal, and so he does not always choose his means carefully.
m920193.うわぁぁああぁ！？\nあっちからも新手が！\nまた囲まれちゃいそうですよ！？:
Waaah!?
Reinforcements from that side, too!
It looks like we're getting surrounded again!?
m920193.えぇ、失敗してしまいましたけど。\nどうやら真実を知るためには、\n聞忠を引きず:
Well, it failed.
It seems we need to drag Wen Zhong out
if we want to know the truth.
m920193.えぇ、魔物の復活と、邪仙による襲撃により、\n華の国の体制は大きく乱れました。:
Yes. The revival of the monsters and the attacks by the wicked immortals
have thrown the Flower Kingdom's order into great disarray.
m920193.おや、もう回り込んで来ましたか。\n――それで、天の声とは何者なのです？:
Oh, they've already flanked us.
―So, who exactly is this Voice of Heaven?
m920193.こちらとしては、あなたが自ら、\n華の国へ身売りしようと\n覚悟を決めていたこと:
On our side, we were more surprised that you had resolved
to sell yourself to the Land of Flowers on your own accord.
m920193.この国にはね、遥かな過去からずっと、\n王家を守護し続けている邪仙がいるのよ。\:
There is a wicked immortal in this country who has been guarding the royal family
since time immemorial.
An overprotective one, to boot.
m920193.これは、最初から見えていた未来ですから。\n邪仙に守られ、邪仙に翻弄されるのが、:
It was a future that was visible from the very start.
As long as the ancient nation of the Land of Flowers remains
protected by a wicked immortal, and manipulated by one.
m920193.これはナタク様、お見苦しいところを。\nそれに太公望様や、清源妙道真君様までお揃:
My apologies for the unsightly display, Nataku-sama.

And what's more, Taigong Wang-sama and Erlang Shen-sama are here as well.
m920193.これは手厳しい。\nでは、華の国が王都にご案内しましょう。:
Harsh words, indeed.

Then, allow me to guide you to the capital of the Kingdom of Flowers.
m920193.さぁ、ちょっと乱戦にさせてもらおうか！: Well then, allow me to cause a bit of a commotion!
m920193.さぁ来るぞ、ワシの死が、\n永劫を生きる邪仙の終わりが――:
Come on then, my death is at hand…

The end of the wicked immortal who lives in eternal damnation—
m920193.さぁ行け。天の声は我らに味方した。\nこの好機を逃せば、華の国の未来は無いものと:
Now go. The heavens have sided with us.
If we let this chance slip, the future of the Land of Flowers is lost!
m920193.さすがは華王、誅子。\n戦場に出ただけで、兵の士気が上がっています。:
Truly worthy of the King of Flowers, Zhuzi.
His mere presence on the battlefield
has already boosted his soldiers' morale.
m920193.さて、世間話をするために\n国家会談を申し入れたわけではないのだ。\nさっそく本:
Now, I did not call this state meeting
to exchange pleasantries.
Let us get straight to business.
m920193.しかし、あちらには神仙郷の者がおります。\nもし戦闘となれば今の戦力では――:
However, there are people from the Land of Immortals on their side.

If it comes to battle, our current forces would be—
m920193.しかし、こちらは場数が違います。\n諦めず、抗い、戦わねばならなかった時に、\n:
However, we have far more experience.
Let us show the difference between those who had to fight
without giving up, and those who stayed hidden.
m920193.して、ここまで話せば\n此度の会談における目的は分かるだろう？:
Having said that,
you should understand the purpose of this meeting.
m920193.そうすれば、一度は離れた民の心が、\n再び誅子様のもとへ戻ってくるだろうって。:
It said that if I did, the hearts of the people,
who had once turned away, would return to Lady Zhuzi.
m920193.そうも行かない理由があるのよ。\n邪仙の襲撃があったあの時、\nあの過保護で忠義:
There are reasons why it isn't that simple.
At the time of the wicked immortal's attack,
that overprotective, excessively loyal wicked immortal——
m920193.そちらも仙人を出したらどう？\n天の声だ何だと言っているの、どうせ聞忠なんでしょ:
Why don't you bring out an immortal too?
You keep talking about "the voice of heaven,"
but it's just Wen Zhong, isn't it?
m920193.そのとおり！\n仲間を絶対見捨てない、王子がそんな人だから、\n安心して最前線で:
Exactly!
The Prince never abandons his comrades, so
we can fight at the front line with peace of mind!
m920193.その由緒正しい武将が、\n捕虜の首を横から奪いに来たわけです。\n――フェイロン:
So this noble general has come to snatch the head of a prisoner from under our noses.

――Fei-Long, care to explain?
m920193.そんな奴らに、華の国も、誅子様も、\n絶対に好き勝手させたり、したくない。\n僕:
I absolutely refuse to let those people
do whatever they please to the Flower Kingdom or Lady Zhuzi.
Let me join the Kingdom's battle too!
m920193.なっ……王子よ、華の国と事を構えるつもりか！？\nあちらの要求は最初から分かって:
W-What… Prince, do you intend to make enemies of the Land of Flowers?
You must have known what they would ask for from the start!
m920193.なっ、この仙術――目眩ましか！？: Wha— this spell…… did it blind me?!
m920193.ならば、それまで勝ち続けなければ。\n王子殿、誅子の軍を蹴散らしますよ！！:
Then we must keep winning until then.
Your Highness, let us crush Zhuzi's army!!
--- scene: The King of the Flower Kingdom (battle, end) ---
m920193.ならば他の存在……。\n魔界や冥界、あるいはオリュンポスの――:
Then it must be some other existence….
The Demon Realm, the Underworld, or perhaps Olympus—
m920193.はぁ……相変わらず神経を逆撫でする仙人ですね……。\nしかし、勝機はこちらにある: Haa… You immortals always know how to get under my skin… But the advantage is on our side.
m920193.はぁ……首級を譲るわけにはいかないな。\n僕も後を追うとしようか。:
Haa…… I can't let them take the credit for his head.
I suppose I'll have to follow him.
m920193.はぁぁぁ……。\nどうしてこんなことにぃ……！？:
Haaah…….
Why is this happening to me……!?
m920193.はっ。それでは、我が王よ、ご武運を。: Yes, my lord. May victory be yours.
m920193.ははっ、あなたのそんな顔を見るのは初めてです。\nさぁ悪漢に追われる姫君よ、\n:
Haha, I've never seen you look like that before.
Well then, princess fleeing from scoundrels,
let us guard this place for you.
m920193.ははっ、もうかつての妹分ではないぞ。\n……あれから、背負うものも増えたからな。:
Haha, I am no longer the little sister you knew.
…I have taken on many burdens since then.
m920193.ほう、この場所での戦闘は、\nむしろそちらが仕掛けたものだというのか。:
Hmph. So the battle here
was actually the one you initiated.
m920193.ほざけ。\n貴様の顔を毎朝毎晩見ていれば、\n美男美女など興味もなくなるわ。:
Nonsense.

Seeing your face every morning and every night

takes all the interest out of handsome men and beautiful women.
m920193.まさか、この状況で、\n華の国と戦端を開くことになるとは……。:
I never imagined we'd be forced to open hostilities with the Land of Flowers
in a situation like this…
m920193.また敵を煽って……。\nいや、むしろ本音を引き出すつもりなのでしょうか。:
Prodding the enemy again…
No, perhaps he's trying to draw out their true feelings.
m920193.む……またあなたの手のひらの上か……。\nまぁいいさ、踊ると決めたんだ、最後まで:
Mm… I'm dancing on your palm again, aren't I…
Well, fine. I've decided to dance,
so I'll dance until the very end.
m920193.やはり王国は手強い、か。\nふざけた連中だが、その練度が段違いだ。:
So the kingdom is indeed a tough opponent.
They're a bunch of fools, but their training is on a whole different level.
m920193.やれやれ……決裂、か。\n見返りに、神との決戦には\n華の国の全軍を提供しようと:
Well, well… a rupture, then.
I had hoped to offer the full might of the Land of Flowers' army
for the decisive battle against the gods, in return…
m920193.ようやく来た！\nみんな、こっち！ 橋の前まで抜けるよ！:
We're here at last!
Everyone, this way! We can break through to the bridge!
m920193.よかろう。\nならば実力にて、十天君がひとり、\n金光聖菩の首を貰い受けよう！:
Very well.
Then let us take the heads of one of the Ten Heavenly Kings,
Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu, by force!
m920193.オリュンポス……第二層、崑崙。\nまさか、亜神との戦いが、\n華の国にまで波及し: Olympus… The Second Layer, Kunlun. I never imagined the war with the sub-gods would have such far-reaching consequences, even reaching the Flower Kingdom.
m920193.オリュンポスってところにいるのは、\n実際にはヤバイ連中なんだろ？:
The ones living at Olympus…
they're actually a pretty dangerous bunch, aren't they?
m920193.チィッ、華の国の狂犬の後は王国か！: Tch, after the Flower Kingdom's mad dog, it's the Kingdom!
m920193.ヌゥゥッ！\nだが、ワシもここで散るわけにはいかぬ。\nチェェェェェイッ！！:
Nuuuuh!
But I can't just let myself fall here.
Cheeeeeei!!
m920193.フェイロン、あなたほどの武将が、\nなぜ誅子に進言しなかったのですか。\n聞忠の:
Fei-Long, a general of your caliber,
why did you not advise Zhuzi?
Wenzhong's actions risk plunging the nation into chaos again.
m920193.フェイロン、それで、\nこれからどうするつもりですか？\n内情を明かした以上、あ:
Fei-Long, so,
what do you intend to do now?
Having revealed the inside story, you are a traitor.
m920193.フンッ！ ワシの邪魔をするというのなら、\nこのまま押し通るッ！！:
Hmph! If you think you can stop me,
I'll just push right through you!!
m920193.上に立つ者は、えてして自覚がないものですから。\n自分がどれだけお人好しなのか、:
Those in high positions often lack self-awareness.
There are princes who have no idea how naive they truly are.
m920193.亜神ディアス……亜神ヒュープ……。\nいえ、彼らが華の国に手を伸ばす理由がない。:
The Lesser God Dias… the Lesser God Hup…
No, they have no reason to reach out to the Land of Flowers.
m920193.仙人ならぬその身では、\nワシを追うことなどできまい！\nヌハハハハハッ！！:
With that body of yours, far from being an immortal,
you'll never catch me!
Nuhahahahaha!!
m920193.仲間を売って得たような戦力など、\n王子は望みはしないでしょう。:
The Prince would not want a military strength
gained by selling out his comrades.
m920193.伏龍の軍師、か。うむ、恐れ入った！\nだが、純粋な武力のぶつかり合いではどうだ？:
So, the Fulong's strategist.
I'm impressed!
But how about a pure clash of military might?
m920193.元より、オリュンポスには挑まねばならなかったのです。\n敵の手のひらで踊らされる: It was always necessary to challenge Olympus. I dislike being played for a fool, but…
m920193.先程、フェイロンさんからお聞きしました。\n……中々に、強引な手段を用いているよ:
I just heard from Fei-Long.
…It seems they are using rather forceful methods.
m920193.十天君、金光聖菩の身柄を、\nこちらへ渡してもらいたい。:
We wish for you to hand over the persons of the Ten Heavenly Kings
and Jin-Guang Sheng-Pu.
m920193.博打はもとより余の生き甲斐よ。\n今は何より、手数が惜しい。\n貴様の実力を遊ば:
Gambling is, and always has been, my passion.

Right now, I can't afford to waste a single move.

I can't let your talents go to waste.
m920193.吹き込んだとは人聞きの悪い。\nただ私は、天の声を伝えただけですよ。: Whisper? What a way to put it. I merely conveyed the voice of heaven.
m920193.問題は、十天君の襲来に際し、\nその邪仙――聞忠が誅子を匿ってしまったこと。\n:
The problem is that when the Ten Heavenly Kings attacked,
that wicked immortal—Wenzhong—hid Zhu-zi away.
The people of this country took it to mean the King had fled in the face of the enemy.
m920193.大切な者を守ろうとする、\nその気持ちは分かるけど、ね。:
I understand the desire to protect those you hold dear,
but still.
m920193.天の声がね、こう告げたんだ。\n十天君を討伐せよ、と。:
A voice from the heavens told me this.
Defeat the Ten Heavenly Kings.
m920193.太公望……！\nあなたに教える義理はありませんよ！:
Taigong Wang…!
I have no obligation to tell you!
m920193.太公望、敵をからかう悪い癖が出ていますよ。: Taigong Wang, you're showing that bad habit of taunting the enemy.
m920193.客人に手を出すのはご法度だけど、\nそれ以上に、十天君を\n渡すわけにはいかない:
It's improper to attack a guest,
but there are reasons why I absolutely cannot let the Ten Heavenly Kings
fall into their hands.
m920193.強がりもそこまでだ。\n十天君がひとり、狛天君よ！\n我が祖国を害したその罪、こ:
Enough with the bravado.
You are just one of the Ten Heavenly Kings, Komaten!
Pay for the crimes you've committed against my homeland with your life!
m920193.当然だよ。\nボクを誰だと思っているの？:
Of course.
Who do you think I am?
m920193.待ち伏せは最初から織り込み済み。\n誅子率いる華の国軍との激突は、\nどうあがい:
The ambush was planned from the start.
No matter what we do,
we can't avoid a clash with the Flower Kingdom army led by Zhuzi.
m920193.我が華の国は、いま十天君の討伐を進めておる。\n知ってのとおり、彼奴らは祖国の仇:
Our Land of Flowers is currently pursuing the subjugation of the Ten Heavenly Kings.
As you know, they are the enemies of our homeland.
m920193.戦場は整いました。\nどうせ、あなたたちも来るつもりだったのでしょう？: The battlefield is set. I assume you were going to come anyway?
m920193.攻撃の手を休めるな！\n地の利はこちらにある！:
Don't let up on the attack!
The terrain is in our favor!
m920193.特に、国家の長たる華王、誅子が存命であることが、\n華の国の復興の大きな足枷とな:
In particular, the fact that the King of Flowers, Zhu Zi, is still alive
has become a major hindrance to the nation's recovery.
m920193.狛天君の首が手土産になるならそれで構いません。\n王国を巻き込もうというのなら、:
If Komaten's head is meant as a gift, then very well.

But if you intend to drag the Kingdom into this,

you will have to provide a proper explanation.
m920193.狛天君！\nまた何か悪巧みを――というわけでもなさそうだ。\n手負いの今こそ、ヤ:
Komaten!
It doesn't look like he's plotting anything new.
Now that he's wounded, this is our chance to capture him!
m920193.王子に惚れ込んだあなたが妙なことを。\n王子が、一時的にとはいえ、\n仲間を売る:
How uncharacteristic of someone who has fallen for the Prince.
The Prince would never do something like sell out his allies,
even temporarily.
m920193.王子殿下、僕の武技を、あなたに捧げよう。\nどうか共に、偽りの神を打ち砕いてほし:
Your Highness, I dedicate my martial arts to you.
Please, let us shatter the false gods together!
--- scene: The King of the Flower Kingdom (battle, start) ---
m920193.知ったことか！\n兵よ聞け、仙人を人と思うな！ 多数で圧殺しろ！:
I don't care!
Soldiers, listen! Do not think of the immortals as mere men! Crush them with numbers!
m920193.神――いいえ、亜神の声をですか。\nどこの者とも知れぬ声に惑わされ、\n挙句の果: The voice of a god? No, a sub-god? To be swayed by the words of an unknown entity, and in the end, cause your master's battles to falter and end in defeat…
m920193.私ひとりならば、華の国を出し抜くことなど容易い。\n王子の面子を守るため、一度は:
If it were just me, slipping past the Land of Flowers would have been easy.
If you had just nodded along to save face,
things would have gone much more smoothly…
m920193.美男美女に目のなかった遊び人のあなたが、\n今や華の国の王として、\n国家の復興:
You, who used to be a playboy with eyes only for beauty,

are now fighting for the restoration of the nation

as the King of Flowers.
m920193.聞きなさい、神仙郷の者たちよ。\nあなたたちが敬愛し、師事した偉大なる神仙。\n: Listen well, you of the Land of Immortals. The great deity you revere and have studied under… Yuanshi Tianzun has taken our side.
m920193.聞忠、いったい華の国に、\n何を吹き込んだのですか。: Wen Zhong, what on earth did you whisper to the people of the Flower Kingdom?
m920193.華の国が王、誅子の側近がひとり。\n彼の国を守護する古い家系の者です。:
He is one of the close retainers of the King of Flowers, Chushi.

He comes from an ancient lineage that has guarded his nation.
m920193.詳しい話と、他の十天君の居場所、\n王国に戻ったら詳しく聞かせてもらわないとね。:
We'll hear the full story and the whereabouts of the other Ten Heavenly Kings
once we're back in the Kingdom.
m920193.誅子は紛れもない善王だったけれど、\nただ一度の過ちで、\n華の国は取り返しのつ:
Zhu-zi was truly a benevolent king, but
that single mistake
inflicted an irreparable wound on the Land of Flowers.
m920193.都の外まで至れば本隊と合流できます！\nこのまま城を抜け、街まで撤退を！:
If we make it outside the capital, we can link up with the main force!
Let's push through the castle and retreat to the city!
m920193.金光聖菩さんを渡さないって、\n断言しちゃったからかなぁ……？: Maybe it's because we flatly refused to hand over the Golden Light Bodhisattva……?
m920193.魔物の復活以前には、\n頻度は多くありませんが、国交がありましたから。:
Before the monsters were revived,
the two nations had diplomatic ties, though not often.
m920193.魔王を倒し、今や世界を救わんとするだけある。\nしかし、こちらにも祖国の未来がか:
I defeated the Demon King and saved the world. That's what they say.
But my homeland's future is at stake, too.
m920193.魔王を討ち、神とすら戦わんとする王国軍。\nされどその退路は絶たれ、\n本隊から:
The Kingdom army that slew the Demon King
and dares to fight even the gods.
Yet your retreat is cut off,
and you are far from your main force.

m930021.──某月某日、東の国。: (narration): ──Some month, some day, in the Eastern Kingdom.
m930021.あの日を境に、多くの公家が西の京を脱しました。\n築き上げた歴史と伝統、誇りの全:
Since that day, many nobles have fled the Western Capital—
throwing away all the history, tradition, and pride they'd built—
m930021.いいところに来てくれたね、王国諸君！: You've arrived at just the right time, lords of the kingdom!
m930021.おっと、滅多なことを口にするものじゃないよ。\n私たちの仲だもの、まさか断ったり:
Hey, don't say such reckless things.
We're friends, you wouldn't turn us down, would you?
m930021.この国で最も偉いのは国主じゃない。\n主上──西の京におわす『帝』なのさ。:
The highest authority here isn't the ruler. 
The true sovereign is the “Emperor” who resides in the Western Capital.
m930021.この辺りの上下関係は少し複雑でね。\n本来武家の棟梁である国主という地位は、\n:
The hierarchy around here is a bit tangled. 
The position of ruler, traditionally the head of the samurai clan, is appointed by the Emperor.
m930021.そう、ちょっくら西の京まで一緒に来てくれない？\nさすがに朝廷も王国の存在を軽視:
Exactly—could you come with us to the Western Capital, even just a little?
The court can't afford to ignore the Kingdom's presence, after all.
m930021.そうだね、似たようなものかもしれない。\nだけど、近年はその両翼の断絶が酷かった:
Yeah, something like that. 
But in recent years the rift between the two wings has grown severe.
m930021.そう言ってくれると信じてたよ。\nそれではいざ行かん、西の京へ！: I knew you'd say that. Then, let's set off for the Western Capital!
m930021.そこからはもう早かったなー。\n帝は大々的に朝廷の復活を宣言、\n西の京も急速に:
From there things moved fast.
The emperor publicly declared the court's revival, and the Western Capital rebuilt in a hurry.
m930021.そこで君たち王国の力を借りたいってわけ！: That's why we want to borrow the Kingdom's strength!
m930021.ちなみに先代国主の後継者がシズカだから、\n厳密に言うと私は国主代理の代理なんだ:
By the way, Shizuka is the heir of the previous ruler, so technically I'm just a proxy for the proxy of the ruler— 
because my sister's political skill is catastrophically lacking, I had no choice—
m930021.で、満を持して国主の呼び出しってわけ。\n裏に公家も武家も陰陽師もいるんだろうね:
And now, with everything set, the ruler's summons has come.
Behind the scenes, nobles, samurai, and onmyōji are all involved.
Ugh, politics is such a hassle.
m930021.でも、そうはならなかったんですね？: But it didn't turn out that way, did it?
m930021.でも、最近まで朝廷の話なんて……。: But until recently, we never even heard about court matters…
m930021.でも正直なところ、西の京は終わったと思ったよ。\nあそこから立て直せる未来が、私:
Honestly, I thought the Western Capital was finished.
I couldn't see any future where it could be rebuilt.
m930021.ま、まだ悪い方向に行くと決まったわけでは……。: Well, that doesn't mean it's destined to go the wrong way…
m930021.ようこそ陰謀蔓延る不穏の園！ 内戦間近の火薬庫へ！\n我々は君たちを歓迎するよ！:
Welcome to this ominous garden where conspiracies fester! To the powder keg on the brink of civil war! 
We extend our warmest welcome to you—from the bottom of our hearts!
m930021.今それを言わなくてもいいでしょ！: You don't have to say that right now!
m930021.今朝、西の京から届いたばかりの綸旨よ。\n内容は……平たく言うと朝廷への出仕命令:
It's a decree that just arrived this morning from the Western Capital. 
In short, it's an order to report to the court. 
“Come greet us; we're holding a festival.”
m930021.何十年か前には武家と朝廷の戦も起きたぐらいだ。\n私たちの間にはどうしようもない: Decades ago there was even a war between the samurai and the court. The divide between us became insurmountable, and even when the monsters returned we couldn't coordinate at all.
m930021.先帝がお隠れになってから朝廷は機能を停止、\n陰陽頭が姿を消した陰陽寮もそのまま:
Since the former Emperor went into hiding, the court has ground to a halt, and the Onmyō Guild vanished along with its head. 
Still, the biggest problem was—
m930021.公家は野蛮で教養のない武士を明らかに見下していたし、\n武家はそれに対し『口だけ: The aristocrats openly despised the “barbaric, uncultured” samurai, and the samurai retorted that the aristocrats were all talk and no substance.
m930021.命令って……ヨシノ様が東の国の国主様なのでは？: An order… isn't Yoshino-sama the ruler of the Eastern Kingdom?
m930021.天界での戦いを終えて、数か月後のことだったかな。\nとある陰陽師が、新たな帝を連:
After the battle in the Heavens, a few months later, I think.
A certain onmyōji returned to the Western Capital, bringing a new emperor with him.
m930021.東の都を中心に、軍事と行政を担う武家。\n西の京で帝を支え、文化と政治を司る公家:
The samurai families handled military and administration around the Eastern capital, while the aristocrats in the Western Capital supported the Emperor and oversaw culture and politics. 
Those two wings were supposed to be the backbone of the Eastern Kingdom.
m930021.決まってるよ、これだけは間違いない。\n武家や公家なんて元から野心の塊だしね。:
It's already decided, one thing's for sure.
Nobles and samurai have been power-hungry from the start.
m930021.私は別に公家の責任だとは思わないけどね。\n武家だって同じく無様を晒していたわけ:
I don't really blame the nobles.
The samurai were just as disgraceful, after all.
m930021.私も叩けば埃の出てくる身だし、\n国主の地位を狙っている輩も多い。:
I'm the kind of person who'll stir up dust if you poke me,
and there are plenty of folks eyeing the ruler's seat.
m930021.詳しいことはこの書類を見てくれたまえよ！: Take a look at this document for the details!
m930021.貴族と騎士のような関係、でしょうか？: So, a relationship like nobles and knights, perhaps?
m930021.魔物の復活で西の京も派手に燃えたからねぇ。\n風神に荒らされた私たちの都も中々だ:
The resurgence of monsters set the Western Capital ablaze, after all. 
Our own capital was ravaged by the Wind God, and I've heard the west suffered just as badly.

m940009.――いいえ、それには及びません。\nこんなこともあろうかと、\n既に駆けつけてお:
Holmes ――No need.
Just in case something like this came up,
I've already rushed over.
m940009.――ここに宿敵、大神ハイドースを討つッ！！: ――Here, I shall slay my archenemy, the Great God Hydos!!
m940009.――だいぶ狭くなってきましたね。\nそれに、計器の乱れが増大しています。:
――It's getting quite narrow down here.
And the instruments are becoming increasingly erratic.
m940009.――なんだ、もう死んだのか？\n我が死をもたらした戦士、白の皇帝。:
――What? You're dead already?
The warrior who brought about my death, the White Emperor.
m940009.――よくぞここまで耐えたものだ。\nこの一撃をもって、終わりとしよう。:
――You have endured admirably.
Let this single strike be your end.
m940009.――タルタロスの門が、開きかけている……！: ――The gates of Tartarus are starting to open……!
m940009.――ヴァルデさん！\nドーンブリンガーが強大な魔力を感知しました！:
――Walde!
Doombringer has detected a massive surge of magic!
m940009.――世界は、まだ、続くということか。: ――So the world is to continue, is it?
m940009.――俺に言いたいことがあるのだろう。\n冥界から来た、竜人の娘。:
――You have something to say to me.
Daughter of the dragon-people from the Netherworld.
m940009.――全機関出力最大！\nどんどんぶん回せーッ！！:
—Maximum output on all systems!
Push it to the limit!!
m940009.――冗談を。\nこんな大変な状況で帝位簒奪をしろと？:
――Don't be ridiculous.
You want me to seize the throne
in the middle of all this?
m940009.――君を、愛している。\n永遠に、世界が終わろうとも。:
――I love you.
Forever, even if the world ends.
m940009.――如何なる敵が現れようと、\n勝利を掴み続ける、強く美しい国に。:
――A strong, beautiful nation that will
keep seizing victory, no matter what enemy appears.
m940009.――帰るぞ。勝利の凱旋だ。: —let us go home. This is a triumph.
m940009.――我が名はカルペム！\nタルタロスの門を守護する者！:
――My name is Carpem!
Guardian of the Gates of Tartarus!
m940009.――技術書ではなく、\nおとぎ話の本をこんな真剣に眺める日がくるとは……。: ??? ――I never thought I'd be staring at a book of fairy tales with such intensity…
m940009.――接敵！\n……で、でも、なんですかあれ！？:
――Contact!
……B-But what on earth are those things!?
m940009.――数日前、タルタロスへ続く回廊: (narration): ――A few days earlier, in the corridor leading to Tartarus
m940009.――敵の勢いが止まらないでありますよ！？: ――The enemy's assault shows no sign of slowing down!
m940009.――曰く、\n暗黒の奈落、無限の回廊、滅びをもたらすもの、\nある存在が封印され: ――it described it as the Abyss of Darkness, the Infinite Corridor, the Bearer of Ruin. A door that must never be opened, sealing away a certain existence.
m940009.――物質界が、冥界に、侵食されている。: —The Material World is being eroded by the Netherworld.
m940009.――物質界各国から、冥界軍の出現が報告されている。\n同時に、冥界の侵食も広がり:
――Reports are coming in from across the Material World regarding the appearance of Netherworld forces.
Simultaneously, the Netherworld's erosion is spreading,
and they are said to be fully occupied with defense.
m940009.――見えた。\n目視にて冥界の侵食地点を確認！:
—I see it.
Visual confirmation of the Netherworld's erosion point!
m940009.…………。\nいえ、もしかして――:
Dagmar …………
No, wait, could it be――
m940009.…………はい。\n王国もドーンブリンガーを出しましょう。\n兵員輸送に必要でしょ:
…………Yes.
The Kingdom will deploy the Dawnbringer as well.
It will be necessary for troop transport.
m940009.……あとは、帝国をどうするか、だな。:
……The only question now is what to do
with the Empire.
m940009.……いや、待て！\nなんだこれ……何が起きて……。:
……No, wait!
What is this…… what's happening…….
m940009.……ごめんなさい。\n私たちの一族にも、それは伝わっていないわ。:
……I'm sorry.
Even our clan has no knowledge of it.
m940009.……その強さの源までは分からなかった。\nでも、頼るべき力を持つ者だと理解できた:
……I couldn't discern the source of that power.
But I understand that you possess a strength worth relying on.
m940009.……それなら、敵将に聞けばいい。\nおあつらえ向きに、自分から出てきた奴がいるぜ:
……In that case, we just ask the enemy commander.
Conveniently, one of them came out on their own.
m940009.……どうでしょうね。\nもう、そんな感情すら残っていないかもしれないわ。:
……I suppose so.
Though perhaps not even that feeling remains.
m940009.……どれだけ保たせますか。: ……How long do you expect us to hold out?
m940009.……なんだろ。何だか変な感じ。\nハイドースの配下にしては、敵意を感じない。:
……What is it? It feels off.
For a subordinate of Hades, I don't sense any hostility.
m940009.……もう、それすら分からないのかもしれないわ。: ……Perhaps I no longer even know that.
m940009.……やめなさい、ハイドース。\nその門を開けば、あなたも無事では済まないわ。:
……Stop, Hydos.
If you open that gate,
you won't come out of it unscathed.
m940009.……タルタロスの門まで、あと少しよ。: ……We're almost at the gates of Tartarus.
m940009.……タルタロスの魔力を浴びたのか。: ……He must have been exposed to Tartarus's magic.
m940009.……ッ、目眩がするな、こんな濃厚な魔力。: ……Ugh, my head is spinning. Such a dense concentration of magic.
m940009.……世界は、捨てたものではない。: ……The world is not something to be discarded.
m940009.……各居留地に、謝礼はたっぷり渡しておけ。\n襲撃ではなく、手を差し伸べることを:
……Ensure each settlement is amply compensated.
They chose to extend a hand rather than attack.
We must repay that kindness.
m940009.……庇護すべき者、死すべき運命にある人の子に、\n我が意志を委ねはしない。:
……I will not entrust my will to children of men
who are destined to die, whom I should protect.
m940009.……急ぐぞ。\nタルタロスの門まで、あとどれくらいだ。:
……We need to hurry.
How much further to the gate of Tartarus?
m940009.……王の顔に、なったな。: ……You've taken on the face of a king.
m940009.……皆、外を見なさい。\nそれで、分かるはずよ。:
……Everyone, look outside.
You'll see for yourselves.
m940009.……騒々しいな。\n戦闘中かと思ったぞ。:
Tilt ……What a racket.
I thought we were in combat.
m940009.あ、あ、あ、あんなのと鍔迫り合いをぉ！？: A, a, a, a sword fight with something like that!?
m940009.ああ……っ、ペルセフォネ、\nもう、決して、君をひとりにはしない……！！:
Ah…! Persephone,
I will never, ever leave you alone again…!!
m940009.ああ、この場は任せる。\n冥界軍の相手は頼んだ。:
Ah, I'll leave this to you.
I've entrusted the Netherworld forces to you.
m940009.ああ、ペルセフォネ……我が妻にも手伝ってもらおう。\n彼女は本当に慈悲深く、優し:
Ah, Persephone…… I shall call upon my wife as well.
She is truly a merciful and gentle soul.
She will surely heal the souls of the Underworld――
m940009.ああ、我が宿敵、\n憎き仇敵たる男、白の帝国が皇帝よ。:
Yes. My archenemy,
the man who is my bitterest foe, Emperor of the White Empire.
m940009.ああ、生ある者たちが、生きることを望んだ結果だ。: Yes. It is the result of the living desiring to live.
m940009.ああ。ここを決戦の地としよう。: Aye. Let this be the place of the final battle.
m940009.ああ！ 観測装置が振り切れてる！\n来るぞ、タルタロスの奥から、何かが――！！:
Yes! The observation instruments are maxing out!
Something's coming from the depths of Tartarus――!!
m940009.あの瞳には、見覚えがある。\n大切な何かを背負い、彷徨う者の目だ。:
I recognize those eyes.
They are the eyes of someone who bears a heavy burden and wanders in confusion.
m940009.あやつの戦いぶりは、こちらを試すものだ。\n裏切り先を探しているのか、\n他の理:
Her combat style is a test of us.
I don't know if she's looking for a new master to betray us to,
or if there's some other reason.
m940009.いいえ、メカの方ではなくて。\nそうですよ、もっとこの世界には\nもっと古い時代: Dagmar No, not the mechanical part. That's it! We just learned that there are even older eras in this world.
m940009.いやー、終わることがわかってる平和とか、\nほんとなにも味がしないっていうかー。:
Meer It's just that peace you know is about to end…
It really has no flavor to it, you know?
m940009.うおぉぉぉッ！\n魔導エンジン全開！ オーバーレブなんて怖くない！:
Woah!!
Magical engine at full throttle! I'm not afraid of over-revving!
m940009.うきゃー！？\n耳元で太鼓叩くの禁止ー！！:
Meer Ukyaa!?
